routines.name: private.weekly_source_lock_family_rows_v1
lockMutationStatements:
for v_family in
    select distinct_family.trimmed_booking_id,distinct_family.booking_id
    from (
      select distinct
        pg_catalog.btrim(timesheet.booking_id) as trimmed_booking_id,
        timesheet.booking_id as booking_id
      from public.timesheets timesheet
      where timesheet.timesheet_id=any(v_ids)
    ) distinct_family
    order by distinct_family.trimmed_booking_id,distinct_family.booking_id
  loop
    perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
      pg_catalog.hashtext(v_family.trimmed_booking_id)
    )

if v_family.booking_id<>v_family.trimmed_booking_id then
      perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(pg_catalog.hashtext(v_family.booking_id))

perform 1
    from public.timesheets timesheet
    where timesheet.booking_id=v_family.booking_id
    for update

routines.name: public._pay_workbench_candidate_serial_try_gate
lockMutationStatements: v_locked := COALESCE(pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_serial_key, 24062027)), false)

insert into public.audit_events(

    p_after_json,
    nullif(btrim(p_reason), ''),

    nullif(btrim(v_actor_display), ''),

  )

routines.name: public.candidate_workflow_transition_atomic_v1
lockMutationStatements:
perform 1 from public.timesheets
      where timesheet_id=v_paper_timesheet_id and is_current=true and archived_at_utc is null
      for update

select * into v_workflow
      from public.candidate_submission_workflows
      where id=p_workflow_id and environment=v_environment
      for update

else
      select * into v_workflow
      from public.candidate_submission_workflows
      where id=p_workflow_id and environment=v_environment
      for update

select * into v_workflow
    from public.candidate_submission_workflows
    where id=p_workflow_id and environment=v_environment
    for update

select * into v_approval
    from public.candidate_approval_requests
    where id=v_request_id
      and workflow_id=v_workflow.id
      and workflow_generation=v_workflow.generation
      and method in ('','')
      and state=''
      and expires_at_utc>p_now_utc
      and review_manifest_sha256=v_workflow.review_manifest_sha256
    for update

select * into v_source_workflow
    from public.candidate_submission_workflows
    where id=p_workflow_id
      and environment=v_environment
      and account_id=v_account_id
      and candidate_id=v_candidate_id
    for update

select * into v_existing_workflow
    from public.candidate_submission_workflows
    where account_id=v_account_id
      and idempotency_key=btrim(p_idempotency_key)
    for update

select * into v_existing_workflow
    from public.candidate_submission_workflows
    where replacement_of_workflow_id=v_source_workflow.id
    for update

select current_week.* into v_week
      from public.contract_weeks current_week
      where current_week.id=v_source_workflow.contract_week_id
        and current_week.contract_id is not distinct from v_source_workflow.contract_id
        and current_week.week_ending_date is not distinct from v_source_workflow.week_ending_date
      for update

if v_week.timesheet_id is not null then
        select current_timesheet.* into v_anchor_timesheet
        from public.timesheets current_timesheet
        where current_timesheet.timesheet_id=v_week.timesheet_id
          and current_timesheet.is_current=true
          and current_timesheet.archived_at_utc is null
          and current_timesheet.sheet_scope=''::public.timesheet_scope_enum
        for update

if not v_is_rejected_resubmission then
      perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(
        ''||v_account_id::text||''||btrim(p_idempotency_key),0
      ))

select * into v_existing_workflow
      from public.candidate_submission_workflows
      where account_id=v_account_id
        and idempotency_key=btrim(p_idempotency_key)
      for update

select * into v_daily_timesheet
      from public.timesheets
      where timesheet_id=(v_payload->>'')::uuid
        and is_current=true
        and archived_at_utc is null
        and sheet_scope=''::public.timesheet_scope_enum
        and nullif(btrim(coalesce(booking_id,'')),'') is not null
      for update

select * into v_daily_fin
      from public.timesheets_financials
      where timesheet_id=v_daily_timesheet.timesheet_id
        and is_current=true
        and candidate_id=v_candidate_id
      order by computed_at_utc desc nulls last,updated_at desc,id desc
      limit 1
      for update

if v_daily_timesheet.contract_id is not null then
        select * into v_contract
        from public.contracts
        where id=v_daily_timesheet.contract_id and candidate_id=v_candidate_id
        for update

select * into v_contract
      from public.contracts
      where id=(v_payload->>'')::uuid and candidate_id=v_candidate_id
      for update

select * into v_week
      from public.contract_weeks
      where id=(v_payload->>'')::uuid and contract_id=v_contract.id
      for update

select * into v_existing_workflow
    from public.candidate_submission_workflows
    where account_id=v_account_id
      and idempotency_key=btrim(p_idempotency_key)
    for update

if v_workflow_kind in ('','') then
      perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(
        v_candidate_id::text||''||v_contract.id::text||''||
        v_canonical_week_ending_date::text||
        ''
      ))

insert into public.candidate_submission_workflows(
      id,environment,account_id,candidate_id,workflow_kind,scope,route,state,generation,
      contract_id,contract_week_id,anchor_timesheet_id,target_timesheet_id,work_date,week_ending_date,
      policy_snapshot_json,input_snapshot_json,issue_codes,expected_row_signature,idempotency_key,
      replacement_of_workflow_id,creation_request_sha256,creation_identity_json,
      last_mutation_idempotency_key,created_at_utc,updated_at_utc
    ) values (
      v_insert_workflow_id,v_environment,v_account_id,v_candidate_id,v_workflow_kind,
      v_scope,v_route,'',1,v_contract.id,
      case when v_workflow_kind='' then null else v_week.id end,
      case when v_workflow_kind='' then v_daily_timesheet.timesheet_id else v_anchor_week.timesheet_id end,
      case
        when v_workflow_kind='' then v_daily_timesheet.timesheet_id
        when v_workflow_kind='' then null
        else v_week.timesheet_id
      end,
      v_canonical_work_date,v_canonical_week_ending_date,
      v_policy,coalesce(v_payload->'',''::jsonb),''::jsonb,
      nullif(v_payload->>'',''),btrim(p_idempotency_key),
      v_replacement_of_workflow_id,v_creation_request_sha256,v_creation_identity,
      btrim(p_idempotency_key),p_now_utc,p_now_utc
    ) returning * into v_workflow
perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_paper_family_key,0))

if v_paper_timesheet_id is not null
         and (v_action in ('','')
           or (v_workflow.route=''
             and v_workflow.state in ('',''))) then
        perform 1
        from public.timesheets
        where timesheet_id=v_paper_timesheet_id
          and is_current=true
          and archived_at_utc is null
        for update

select * into v_workflow
      from public.candidate_submission_workflows
      where id=p_workflow_id
        and environment=v_environment
        and candidate_id=v_candidate_id
      for update

else
      select * into v_workflow
      from public.candidate_submission_workflows
      where id=p_workflow_id
      for update

select update_row.* into v_pending_expense_update
    from public.candidate_pending_expense_updates update_row
    where update_row.update_id=(v_payload->>'')::uuid
      and update_row.workflow_id=v_workflow.id
      and update_row.current_workflow_generation=v_workflow.generation
      and update_row.state=''
      and update_row.actor_kind=v_expense_update_context->>''
      and update_row.actor_id is not distinct from nullif(
        v_expense_update_context->>'',''
      )::uuid
    for update

update public.candidate_approval_requests set
      state='',superseded_at_utc=p_now_utc,updated_at_utc=p_now_utc
    where workflow_id=v_workflow.id and state in ('','')

insert into public.candidate_submission_components(
        workflow_id,workflow_generation,component_no,timesheet_id,component_kind,expense_category,
        document_role,state,source_component_id,storage_key,media_type,byte_size,source_content_sha256,
        immutable_at_utc,required,review_render_state,final_signed_render_state,created_at_utc
      ) values (
        v_workflow.id,v_next_generation,v_component_no,v_workflow.target_timesheet_id,
        v_source_component.component_kind,v_source_component.expense_category,v_source_component.document_role,
        '',coalesce(v_source_component.source_component_id,v_source_component.id),
        v_source_component.storage_key,v_source_component.media_type,v_source_component.byte_size,
        v_source_component.source_content_sha256,p_now_utc,false,'','',p_now_utc
      )

update public.candidate_submission_components set
      state='',superseded_at_utc=p_now_utc,
      review_render_state=case when review_render_state='' then review_render_state else '' end,
      final_signed_render_state=case when final_signed_render_state='' then final_signed_render_state else '' end
    where workflow_id=v_workflow.id
      and workflow_generation=v_workflow.generation
      and state<>''

update public.candidate_submission_workflows set
      state='',generation=v_next_generation,
      input_snapshot_json=coalesce(v_payload->'',input_snapshot_json),
      candidate_signature_component_id=null,candidate_signature_sha256=null,candidate_signed_at_utc=null,
      review_manifest_json=null,review_manifest_sha256=null,paper_return_manifest_json=null,
      paper_return_manifest_sha256=null,renderer_contract_version=null,
      manager_name=null,manager_position=null,manager_signature_component_id=null,
      manager_signature_sha256=null,manager_approved_at_utc=null,
      issue_codes=''::jsonb,worker_submitted_at_utc=null,
      daily_context_sha256=null,canonical_financial_sha256=null,
      canonical_save_input_sha256=null,canonical_save_row_signature=null,
      canonical_save_financials_id=null,canonical_save_receipt_json=null,canonical_saved_at_utc=null,
      last_mutation_idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key,last_mutation_response_json=v_response,
      updated_at_utc=p_now_utc
    where id=v_workflow.id returning * into v_workflow

elsif v_component_kind='' then
      select * into v_approval
      from public.candidate_approval_requests
      where id=nullif(v_payload->>'','')::uuid
        and workflow_id=v_workflow.id
        and workflow_generation=v_workflow.generation
        and method=''
        and state=''
        and review_manifest_sha256=v_workflow.review_manifest_sha256
      for update

if v_component_kind='' and v_approval.id is not null then
      with replaced as (
        update public.candidate_submission_components
        set state='',superseded_at_utc=p_now_utc,
            review_render_state=case
              when review_render_state='' then review_render_state
              else ''
            end,
            final_signed_render_state=case
              when final_signed_render_state='' then final_signed_render_state
              else ''
            end
        where approval_request_id=v_approval.id
          and component_kind=''
          and state in ('','')
          and upload_idempotency_key is distinct from p_idempotency_key
        returning id
      )
      select coalesce(array_agg(id),array[]::uuid[])
      into v_replaced_manager_signature_ids
      from replaced

insert into public.candidate_submission_components(
      workflow_id,workflow_generation,component_no,approval_request_id,timesheet_id,component_kind,expense_category,
      document_role,state,source_component_id,storage_key,media_type,byte_size,source_content_sha256,
      upload_idempotency_key,immutable_at_utc,
      required,review_ordinal,review_render_state,final_signed_render_state,paper_return_page_key,
      manager_signature_capture_method,expected_source_content_sha256,created_at_utc
    ) values (
      v_workflow.id,v_workflow.generation,v_component_no,
      case when v_component_kind='' then v_approval.id else null end,
      v_workflow.target_timesheet_id,
      v_component_kind,v_expense_category,v_document_role,
      case when v_source_component.id is null then '' else '' end,
      v_source_component.id,
      coalesce(v_source_component.storage_key,nullif(v_payload->>'','')),
      coalesce(v_source_component.media_type,v_requested_media_type),
      coalesce(v_source_component.byte_size,v_requested_byte_size),
      v_source_component.source_content_sha256,p_idempotency_key,
      case when v_source_component.id is null then null else p_now_utc end,
      false,null,'','',v_paper_page_key,
      v_manager_capture_method,v_expected_source_digest,
      p_now_utc
    ) returning * into v_component

elsif v_action='' then
    select * into v_component from public.candidate_submission_components
    where id=nullif(v_payload->>'','')::uuid and workflow_id=v_workflow.id
      and workflow_generation=v_workflow.generation for update

if v_component.component_kind='' then
      if v_approval.id is null then
        select * into v_approval
        from public.candidate_approval_requests
        where id=v_component.approval_request_id
          and workflow_id=v_workflow.id
          and workflow_generation=v_workflow.generation
          and method=''
          and state=''
          and review_manifest_sha256=v_workflow.review_manifest_sha256
        for update

update public.candidate_submission_components set
      state='',source_content_sha256=v_digest,
      byte_size=coalesce(nullif(v_payload->>'','')::bigint,byte_size),
      media_type=coalesce(nullif(lower(v_payload->>''),''),media_type),
      validated_image_width=case when component_kind='' then v_verified_image_width else validated_image_width end,
      validated_image_height=case when component_kind='' then v_verified_image_height else validated_image_height end,
      immutable_at_utc=p_now_utc
    where id=v_component.id and state='' returning * into v_component

update public.candidate_submission_components set
      state='',superseded_at_utc=p_now_utc,
      review_render_state=case when review_render_state='' then review_render_state else '' end,
      final_signed_render_state=case when final_signed_render_state='' then final_signed_render_state else '' end
    where id=nullif(v_payload->>'','')::uuid and workflow_id=v_workflow.id
      and workflow_generation=v_workflow.generation and state<>''
      and component_kind in ('','','')
    returning * into v_component

select * into v_daily_timesheet
      from public.timesheets
      where timesheet_id=v_workflow.target_timesheet_id
        and is_current=true and archived_at_utc is null
        and sheet_scope=''::public.timesheet_scope_enum
      for update

select * into v_daily_fin
      from public.timesheets_financials
      where timesheet_id=v_daily_timesheet.timesheet_id and is_current=true and candidate_id=v_candidate_id
      order by computed_at_utc desc nulls last,updated_at desc,id desc limit 1 for update

elsif v_workflow.workflow_kind in ('','') then
      select * into v_week
      from public.contract_weeks
      where id=v_workflow.contract_week_id
        and contract_id=v_workflow.contract_id
        and week_ending_date=v_workflow.week_ending_date
      for update

else
        select * into v_anchor_timesheet
        from public.timesheets
        where timesheet_id=v_workflow.target_timesheet_id
          and timesheet_id=v_week.timesheet_id
          and is_current=true
          and archived_at_utc is null
          and sheet_scope=''::public.timesheet_scope_enum
        for update

elsif v_workflow.workflow_kind='' then
      select week_row.* into v_anchor_week
      from public.contract_weeks week_row
      join public.timesheets anchor_timesheet
        on anchor_timesheet.timesheet_id=week_row.timesheet_id
       and anchor_timesheet.is_current=true
       and anchor_timesheet.archived_at_utc is null
       and anchor_timesheet.sheet_scope=''::public.timesheet_scope_enum
      where week_row.timesheet_id=v_workflow.anchor_timesheet_id
        and week_row.contract_id=v_workflow.contract_id
        and week_row.week_ending_date=v_workflow.week_ending_date
      for update of week_row,anchor_timesheet

update public.candidate_approval_requests set
      state='',superseded_at_utc=p_now_utc,updated_at_utc=p_now_utc
    where workflow_id=v_workflow.id and state in ('','')
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.candidate_pending_expense_updates pending_update
        where pending_update.workflow_id=v_workflow.id
          and pending_update.state in ('','')
      )

if v_workflow.workflow_kind<>'' then
        select * into v_source_component
        from public.candidate_submission_components
        where id=nullif(v_payload->>'','')::uuid
          and workflow_id=v_workflow.id and component_kind=''
          and document_role='' and state=''
          and source_content_sha256 is not null
          and (
            v_workflow.immutable_submission_sha256 is null
            or v_workflow.immutable_submission_sha256=v_submission_hash
            or (
              v_is_pending_expense_update
              and id=v_workflow.candidate_signature_component_id
              and exists(
                select 1
                from public.candidate_submission_components current_hours
                join public.candidate_submission_components prior_hours
                  on prior_hours.workflow_id=current_hours.workflow_id
                  and prior_hours.workflow_generation=
                    v_pending_expense_update.from_workflow_generation
                  and prior_hours.component_kind=''
                  and prior_hours.state=''
                  and prior_hours.source_content_sha256=current_hours.source_content_sha256
                where current_hours.workflow_id=v_workflow.id
                  and current_hours.workflow_generation=v_workflow.generation
                  and current_hours.component_kind=''
                  and current_hours.state=''
              )
            )
            or (
              source_component_id is null
              and created_at_utc>=coalesce(v_workflow.worker_submitted_at_utc,''::timestamptz)
            )
          )
        for update

insert into public.candidate_submission_components(
          workflow_id,workflow_generation,component_no,timesheet_id,component_kind,document_role,state,
          source_component_id,storage_key,media_type,byte_size,source_content_sha256,immutable_at_utc,
          required,review_ordinal,review_render_state,final_signed_render_state,created_at_utc
        ) values (
          v_workflow.id,v_next_generation,v_component_no,v_workflow.target_timesheet_id,
          '','','',
          coalesce(v_source_component.source_component_id,v_source_component.id),v_source_component.storage_key,
          v_source_component.media_type,v_source_component.byte_size,v_source_component.source_content_sha256,p_now_utc,
          false,null,'','',p_now_utc
        ) returning * into v_signature_component

insert into public.candidate_submission_components(
          workflow_id,workflow_generation,component_no,timesheet_id,component_kind,document_role,state,
          immutable_at_utc,required,review_ordinal,review_render_state,final_signed_render_state,created_at_utc
        ) values (
          v_workflow.id,v_next_generation,v_component_no,v_workflow.target_timesheet_id,'',
          '','',p_now_utc,true,v_review_ordinal,
          '','',p_now_utc
        ) returning * into v_component

insert into public.candidate_submission_components(
          workflow_id,workflow_generation,component_no,timesheet_id,component_kind,document_role,state,
          immutable_at_utc,required,review_ordinal,review_render_state,final_signed_render_state,created_at_utc
        ) values (
          v_workflow.id,v_next_generation,v_component_no,v_workflow.target_timesheet_id,'',
          '','',p_now_utc,false,null,
          '','',p_now_utc
        )

insert into public.candidate_submission_components(
            workflow_id,workflow_generation,component_no,timesheet_id,component_kind,expense_category,
            document_role,state,source_component_id,storage_key,media_type,byte_size,source_content_sha256,
            immutable_at_utc,required,review_ordinal,review_render_state,final_signed_render_state,created_at_utc
          ) values (
            v_workflow.id,v_next_generation,v_component_no,v_workflow.target_timesheet_id,
            v_source_component.component_kind,v_source_component.expense_category,v_source_component.document_role,
            '',coalesce(v_source_component.source_component_id,v_source_component.id),
            v_source_component.storage_key,v_source_component.media_type,v_source_component.byte_size,
            v_source_component.source_content_sha256,p_now_utc,true,v_review_ordinal,'','',p_now_utc
          )

update public.candidate_submission_components set
        state='',superseded_at_utc=p_now_utc,
        review_render_state=case when review_render_state='' then review_render_state else '' end,
        final_signed_render_state=case when final_signed_render_state='' then final_signed_render_state else '' end
      where workflow_id=v_workflow.id and workflow_generation=v_workflow.generation
        and (required=true or document_role='') and state<>''
        and not exists(
          select 1 from public.candidate_pending_expense_updates pending_update
          where pending_update.workflow_id=v_workflow.id
            and pending_update.state in ('','')
        )

update public.candidate_submission_workflows set
        state='',generation=v_next_generation,
        route=case when upper(coalesce(v_payload->>'',route)) in ('','')
          then upper(coalesce(v_payload->>'',route)) else '' end,
        input_snapshot_json=v_immutable_submission,immutable_submission_json=v_immutable_submission,
        immutable_submission_sha256=v_submission_hash,
        policy_snapshot_json=v_policy,policy_snapshot_sha256=private._candidate_sha256_jsonb_v1(v_policy),
        candidate_signature_component_id=case when workflow_kind='' then null else v_signature_component.id end,
        candidate_signature_sha256=case when workflow_kind='' then null else v_signature_component.source_content_sha256 end,
        candidate_signed_at_utc=case when workflow_kind='' then null
          when v_is_pending_expense_update then nullif(
            v_pending_expense_update.prior_workflow_snapshot_json->>'',''
          )::timestamptz
          else coalesce(nullif(v_payload->>'','')::timestamptz,p_now_utc) end,
        renderer_contract_version=coalesce(nullif(btrim(v_payload->>''),''),''),
        review_manifest_json=null,review_manifest_sha256=null,
        manager_name=null,manager_position=null,manager_signature_component_id=null,
        manager_signature_sha256=null,manager_approved_at_utc=null,
        issue_codes=v_server_issue_codes,worker_submitted_at_utc=p_now_utc,
        daily_context_sha256=null,canonical_financial_sha256=null,
        canonical_save_input_sha256=null,canonical_save_row_signature=null,
        canonical_save_financials_id=null,canonical_save_receipt_json=null,canonical_saved_at_utc=null,
        last_mutation_idempotency_key=p_idempotency_key,updated_at_utc=p_now_utc
      where id=v_workflow.id returning * into v_workflow

insert into public.candidate_submission_components(

lockMutationStatements:
perform 1 from public.weekly_source_groups source_group
  where source_group.id=v_group_id or source_group.id=v_locked_old_group_id
  order by source_group.id for update

select * into v_group from public.weekly_source_groups source_group
  where source_group.id=v_group_id for update

select membership.* into v_membership
  from public.weekly_source_group_clients membership
  join public.weekly_source_groups source_group on source_group.id=membership.source_group_id
  where membership.client_id=v_client
    and source_group.agency_id=v_agency and source_group.environment=v_environment
    and v_effective_from between membership.valid_from and coalesce(membership.valid_to,''::date)
  for update of membership

if v_old_group_id is null then
    insert into public.weekly_source_group_clients(
      source_group_id,client_id,valid_from,created_by_user_id
    ) values (v_group_id,v_client,v_membership_effective_from,v_actor)
    returning * into v_membership

elsif v_old_group_id<>v_group_id then
    if v_membership.valid_from=v_effective_from then
      update public.weekly_source_group_clients
      set source_group_id=v_group_id
      where id=v_membership.id returning * into v_membership

update public.weekly_source_group_clients set valid_to=v_effective_from-1
      where id=v_membership.id

insert into public.weekly_source_group_clients(
        source_group_id,client_id,valid_from,valid_to,created_by_user_id
      ) values (v_group_id,v_client,v_effective_from,v_prior_end,v_actor)
      returning * into v_membership

if v_old_group_id is not null then
    select * into v_policy
    from public.weekly_source_client_policies policy
    where policy.source_group_id=v_old_group_id and policy.client_id=v_client
      and v_effective_from between policy.effective_from and coalesce(policy.effective_to,''::date)
    for update

if v_policy_found and v_policy.effective_from=v_effective_from then
    update public.weekly_source_client_policies
    set source_group_id=v_group_id,authority_mode=v_authority,document_mode=v_document,
        self_bill_enabled=v_self_bill,self_bill_correction_presentation=v_correction,
        source_fixed_expenses_enabled=v_source_expenses,

        manager_query_recipient=v_manager_recipient,
        completed_pack_copy_enabled=v_completed_copy,completed_pack_recipient=v_completed_recipient,
        created_by_user_id=v_actor,created_at_utc=pg_catalog.transaction_timestamp()
    where id=v_policy.id

update public.weekly_source_client_policies set effective_to=v_effective_from-1
      where id=v_policy.id

insert into public.weekly_source_client_policies(
      source_group_id,client_id,effective_from,effective_to,
      authority_mode,document_mode,self_bill_enabled,self_bill_correction_presentation,
      source_fixed_expenses_enabled,source_expense_vat_enabled,
      weekly_rate_classification_method,duration_break_tie_rule,
      candidate_queries_enabled,manager_queries_enabled,manager_query_recipient,
      completed_pack_copy_enabled,completed_pack_recipient,created_by_user_id
    ) values (
      v_group_id,v_client,v_policy_effective_from,v_prior_end,
      v_authority,v_document,v_self_bill,v_correction,
      v_source_expenses,v_source_expense_vat,v_rate_method,v_tie_rule,
      v_candidate_queries,v_manager_queries,v_manager_recipient,
      v_completed_copy,v_completed_recipient,v_actor
    )

routines.name: private._invoice_generation_advance_core_v8
lockMutationStatements:
with claim_ids as materialized (
    select (x->>'')::uuid chunk_id
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) x where x->>''=''
  ),
  member_values as materialized (
    select c.id chunk_id,c.operation_id,c.payload_json,
      m.value member,m.ordinality
    from claim_ids q
    join public.invoice_operation_chunks c on c.id=q.chunk_id
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(
      case when jsonb_typeof(c.payload_json->'')=''
          and jsonb_array_length(c.payload_json->'')>0
        then c.payload_json->''
        else coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            '','','',s.value,
            '',s.value) order by s.ordinality)
          from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(
            c.payload_json->'',
            c.payload_json->'',''::jsonb))
            with ordinality s(value,ordinality)
        ),''::jsonb) end) with ordinality m(value,ordinality)
    where c.payload_json->>''<>''
  ),
  members as materialized (
    select m.chunk_id,m.operation_id,m.payload_json,m.member,
      upper(coalesce(m.member->>'','')) source_type,
      case when coalesce(m.member->>'','')~*
        ''
        then(m.member->>'')::uuid end source_id,
      case when coalesce(m.member->>'',
          m.member->>'','')~*
        ''
        then coalesce(m.member->>'',
          m.member->>'')::uuid end timesheet_id,
      nullif(btrim(m.member->>''),'') segment_id,
      coalesce(nullif(btrim(m.member->>''),''),
        encode(digest(concat_ws('',
          upper(coalesce(m.member->>'','')),
          coalesce(m.member->>'',''),
          coalesce(m.member->>'',''),
          coalesce(m.member->>'',''),
          coalesce(m.member->>'','')),''),''))
        source_member_key,
      nullif(btrim(coalesce(m.member->>'',
        m.member->>'','')),'') expected_revision,
      m.ordinality
    from member_values m
  ),
  reference_eval as materialized (
    select distinct on (r.source_member_key) r.*
    from private._invoice_source_reference_validate_batch(coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        '',m.source_member_key,
        '',m.source_type,'',m.source_id,
        '',m.timesheet_id,
        '',m.segment_id,
        '',m.member->>'',
        '',m.payload_json->>'',
        '',m.payload_json->>'',
        '',m.expected_revision)
        order by m.chunk_id,m.ordinality)
      from members m
    ),''::jsonb)) r
    order by r.source_member_key
  ),
  vat_eval as materialized (
    select distinct on (v.source_member_key) v.*
    from private._invoice_generation_vat_policy_batch(coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        '',m.source_member_key,
        '',m.source_type,'',m.source_id,
        '',m.timesheet_id,'',m.segment_id,
        '',coalesce(
          case when m.payload_json->>''
              ~''
              and pg_input_is_valid(
                m.payload_json->>'','')
            then m.payload_json->>'' end,
          (select ts_vat.week_ending_date::text
             from public.timesheets ts_vat
            where ts_vat.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
              and ts_vat.is_current
            limit 1)))
        order by m.chunk_id,m.ordinality)
      from members m
    ),''::jsonb)) v
    order by v.source_member_key
  ),
  correction_scopes as materialized (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      '',''||scope.chunk_id::text,
      '',scope.chunk_id::text,
      '','',
      '',scope.payload_json->>'',
      '',scope.payload_json->>'',
      '',scope.payload_json->>'',
      '',scope.planned_members)
      order by scope.chunk_id),''::jsonb) scopes
    from(
      select m.chunk_id,min(m.payload_json::text)::jsonb payload_json,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          '',m.timesheet_id,
          '',m.source_type,
          '',m.source_id,
          '',m.source_member_key,
          '',m.segment_id,
          '',m.payload_json->>'',
          '',v.vat_rate)
          order by m.ordinality) planned_members
      from members m
      left join vat_eval v on v.source_member_key=m.source_member_key
      group by m.chunk_id
    ) scope
  ),
  correction_eval as materialized (
    select r.*
    from correction_scopes s
    cross join lateral private._invoice_correction_validate_batch(
      s.scopes,(v_now at time zone '')::date) r
  ),  source_eval as materialized (
    select m.chunk_id,m.operation_id,m.timesheet_id,m.segment_id,
      m.source_member_key,m.ordinality,
      tf.id tsfin_id,
      encode(digest(concat_ws('',tf.id::text,tf.timesheet_version::text,
        tf.updated_at::text,ts.version::text,ts.updated_at::text,
        coalesce(tf.invoice_breakdown_json::text,'')),''),'') row_revision,
      array_remove(array[
        case when ts.timesheet_id is null then '' end,
        case when ts.timesheet_id is not null and (not ts.is_current or ts.revoked_at is not null) then '' end,
        case when tf.id is null then '' end,
        case when tf.id is not null and tf.is_stale then '' end,
        case when tf.id is not null and tf.processing_status::text<>'' then '' end,
        case when tf.id is not null and tf.has_rate_issue then '' end,
        case when tf.id is not null and tf.has_pay_channel_issue then '' end,
        case when tf.id is not null and tf.client_id is null then '' end,
        case when tf.id is not null and tf.locked_by_invoice_id is not null then '' end,
        case when ts.authorised_at_server is null
          then '' end,
        case when upper(coalesce(ts.submission_mode::text,''))=''
          and(nullif(ts.qr_signed_hash,'') is null
            or ts.qr_signed_at_utc is null)
          then '' end,
        case when pc.require_reference_to_invoice
          and coalesce(ref.reference_ready,false) is not true
          then coalesce(ref.blocker_code,'') end,
        case when coalesce(tf.mileage_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.mileage_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0
          then case when not exists(
            select 1 from public.timesheet_evidence e
            where e.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
              and upper(coalesce(e.kind,''))=''
              and upper(coalesce(e.processing_state,''))<>''
              and upper(coalesce(e.document_role,'')) not in(
                '','','',
                '')
              and nullif(e.storage_key,'') is not null)
            then '' end end,
        case when(coalesce(tf.mileage_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.mileage_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0)
          and exists(
            select 1 from public.timesheet_evidence e
            where e.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
              and upper(coalesce(e.kind,''))=''
              and upper(coalesce(e.processing_state,''))<>''
              and upper(coalesce(e.document_role,'')) not in(
                '','','',
                '')
              and nullif(e.storage_key,'') is not null
              and e.document_asset_id is null)
          then '' end,
        case when coalesce(tf.expenses_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.expenses_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.travel_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.travel_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.accommodation_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.accommodation_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0
          then case when not exists(
            select 1 from public.timesheet_evidence e
            where e.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
              and upper(coalesce(e.kind,'')) in(
                '','','','','')
              and upper(coalesce(e.processing_state,''))<>''
              and upper(coalesce(e.document_role,'')) not in(
                '','','',
                '','')
              and nullif(e.storage_key,'') is not null)
            then '' end end,
        case when(
            coalesce(tf.expenses_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.expenses_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.travel_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.travel_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.accommodation_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.accommodation_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0)
          and exists(
            select 1 from public.timesheet_evidence e
            where e.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
              and upper(coalesce(e.kind,'')) in(
                '','','','','')
              and upper(coalesce(e.processing_state,''))<>''
              and upper(coalesce(e.document_role,'')) not in(
                '','','',
                '')
              and nullif(e.storage_key,'') is not null
              and e.document_asset_id is null)
          then '' end,
        case when(coalesce(tf.travel_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.travel_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0)
          and not exists(
            select 1 from public.timesheet_evidence e
            where e.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
              and upper(coalesce(e.kind,''))=''
              and upper(coalesce(e.processing_state,''))<>''
              and upper(coalesce(e.document_role,'')) not in(
                '','','',
                '')
              and nullif(e.storage_key,'') is not null)
          then '' end,
        case when(coalesce(tf.accommodation_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.accommodation_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0)
          and not exists(
            select 1 from public.timesheet_evidence e
            where e.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
              and upper(coalesce(e.kind,''))=''
              and upper(coalesce(e.processing_state,''))<>''
              and upper(coalesce(e.document_role,'')) not in(
                '','','',
                '')
              and nullif(e.storage_key,'') is not null)
          then '' end,
        case when(coalesce(tf.other_pay_ex_vat,0)<>0
            or coalesce(tf.other_charge_ex_vat,0)<>0)
          and not exists(
            select 1 from public.timesheet_evidence e
            where e.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
              and upper(coalesce(e.kind,'')) in(
                '','','')
              and upper(coalesce(e.processing_state,''))<>''
              and upper(coalesce(e.document_role,'')) not in(
                '','','',
                '','')
              and nullif(e.storage_key,'') is not null)
          then '' end,
        case when exists(
            select 1 from public.timesheet_evidence e
            join public.invoice_document_assets a
              on a.id=e.document_asset_id
            where e.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
              and upper(coalesce(e.kind,'')) in(
                '','','','','','')
              and upper(coalesce(e.processing_state,''))<>''
              and upper(coalesce(e.document_role,'')) not in(
                '','','',
                '')
              and a.status in(
                '','','','',''))
          then '' end,
        case when coalesce(vat.valid,false) is not true
          then coalesce(vat.blocker_code,'') end,
        case when corr.valid is false
          then coalesce(corr.blocker_code,'') end,
        case when coalesce(vs.hr_validation_required_for_invoice,false)
          and upper(coalesce(tf.hr_crosscheck_status,'')) not in(
            '','','','','')
          then '' end,
        case when coalesce(vs.client_is_nhsp,false)
          and coalesce(vs.nhsp_shift_count,0)>0
          and not exists(
            select 1
            from public.nhsp_shifts ns_ready
            where ns_ready.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
              and ns_ready.invoice_status=''
              and ns_ready.invoice_id is null
              and ns_ready.cancelled_at_utc is null)
          then '' end,
        case when exists(select 1 from public.invoice_lines l join public.invoices i on i.id=l.invoice_id
                         where l.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id and i.status in ('','',''))
             and coalesce(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->>'','')<>'' then '' end
      ],null)::text[] blockers
    from members m
    left join public.timesheets ts on ts.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
    left join public.timesheets_financials tf on tf.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id and tf.is_current
    left join public.v_ts_invoice_precheck pc on pc.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
    left join public.v_timesheets_summary_base vs
      on vs.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id
    left join reference_eval ref on ref.source_member_key=m.source_member_key
    left join vat_eval vat on vat.source_member_key=m.source_member_key
    left join correction_eval corr
      on corr.scope_key=m.chunk_id::text
  ),
  resolver_inputs as materialized (
    select c.id chunk_id,c.payload_json,
      row_number() over(order by c.id)::integer command_no
    from claim_ids q
    join public.invoice_operation_chunks c on c.id=q.chunk_id
    where c.payload_json->>''<>''
  ),
  canonical_now as materialized (
    select ri.chunk_id,r.group_key,r.source_revision_hash,
      r.blocker_code,r.blocker_detail
    from private._invoice_generation_resolve_command_groups(
      (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(ri.payload_json order by ri.command_no),
        ''::jsonb) from resolver_inputs ri),null,v_now) r
    join resolver_inputs ri on ri.command_no=r.command_no
    where r.group_key=case
      when left(coalesce(ri.payload_json->>'',''),9)=''
        then substr(ri.payload_json->>'',10)
      else ri.payload_json->>'' end
  ),
  per_chunk as materialized (
    select c.id chunk_id,
      n.source_revision_hash current_revision,
      coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('',se.timesheet_id,
        '',se.segment_id,
        '',to_jsonb(se.blockers)) order by se.ordinality)
        filter(where cardinality(se.blockers)>0),''::jsonb)
        ||case when n.blocker_code is null then ''::jsonb
          else jsonb_build_array(coalesce(n.blocker_detail,
            jsonb_build_object('',n.blocker_code))) end blockers,
      count(se.timesheet_id)::integer source_count
    from claim_ids q join public.invoice_operation_chunks c on c.id=q.chunk_id
    left join source_eval se on se.chunk_id=c.id
    left join canonical_now n on n.chunk_id=c.id
    group by c.id,n.source_revision_hash,n.blocker_code,n.blocker_detail
  ),
  updated as (
    update public.invoice_operation_chunks c
    set phase=case
          when p.source_count=0 then ''
          when jsonb_array_length(p.blockers)>0 then ''
          when nullif(c.payload_json->>'','') is not null
           and c.payload_json->>''<>p.current_revision then ''
          else '' end,
        status=case
          when p.source_count=0 or jsonb_array_length(p.blockers)>0 then ''
          when nullif(c.payload_json->>'','') is not null
           and c.payload_json->>''<>p.current_revision then ''
          else '' end,
        payload_json=c.payload_json||jsonb_build_object('',p.current_revision,'',p.source_count),
        progress_json=jsonb_build_object('',
          case when p.source_count=0 then ''
               when jsonb_array_length(p.blockers)>0 then ''
               when nullif(c.payload_json->>'','') is not null
                and c.payload_json->>''<>p.current_revision then ''
               else '' end,'',p.source_count),
        error_json=case
          when p.source_count=0 then jsonb_build_object('','','',''::jsonb)
          when jsonb_array_length(p.blockers)>0 then jsonb_build_object('','','',p.blockers)
          when nullif(c.payload_json->>'','') is not null
           and c.payload_json->>''<>p.current_revision then jsonb_build_object('','')
          else null end,
        lease_owner=null,lease_token=null,lease_expires_at_utc=null,
        updated_at_utc=v_now
    from per_chunk p where c.id=p.chunk_id
    returning c.id,c.operation_id,c.status,c.phase,c.error_json
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('',id,'',status,'',phase,'',error_json)),''::jsonb)
  into v_part from updated

with claim_ids as (
    select (x->>'')::uuid chunk_id
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) x where x->>''=''
  ),
  credit_eval as (
    select c.id chunk_id,i.id invoice_id,own.credit_note_id resume_invoice_id,
      encode(digest(concat_ws('',i.id::text,i.updated_at::text,i.status::text,
        i.subtotal_ex_vat::text,i.vat_amount::text,i.total_inc_vat::text),''),'') revision,
      case when i.id is null then ''
           when i.type::text<>'' then ''
           when i.status::text not in ('','') then ''
           when own.credit_note_id is null and exists(select 1 from public.invoices cn where cn.original_invoice_id=i.id and cn.type=''
                       and cn.status in('','','')) then ''
           else null end blocker
    from claim_ids q join public.invoice_operation_chunks c on c.id=q.chunk_id
    left join public.invoices i on i.id=c.entity_id
    left join lateral private._invoice_credit_resume_v1(i.id,c.operation_id,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(c.payload_json#>>'','')
        then(c.payload_json#>>'')::uuid end,null) own on true
    where c.payload_json->>''=''
  ),
  updated as (
    update public.invoice_operation_chunks c
    set phase=case when e.blocker is null then '' else '' end,
        status=case when e.blocker is null then '' else '' end,
        payload_json=c.payload_json||jsonb_build_object('',e.revision,'',e.invoice_id,
          '',e.resume_invoice_id),
        progress_json=jsonb_build_object('',case when e.blocker is null then '' else '' end),
        error_json=case when e.blocker is null then null else jsonb_build_object('',e.blocker,'',c.entity_id) end,
        lease_owner=null,lease_token=null,lease_expires_at_utc=null,
        updated_at_utc=v_now
    from credit_eval e where c.id=e.chunk_id
    returning c.id,c.status,c.phase,c.error_json
  )
  select v_result||coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('',id,'',status,'',phase,'',error_json)),''::jsonb)
  into v_result from updated

with claim_ids as materialized (
    select (x->>'')::uuid chunk_id
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) x where x->>''=''
  ),
  members as materialized (
    select c.id chunk_id,c.payload_json,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(s.value,'')
        then s.value::uuid end timesheet_id
    from claim_ids q join public.invoice_operation_chunks c on c.id=q.chunk_id
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(
      c.payload_json->'',c.payload_json->'',''::jsonb)) s(value)
    where c.payload_json->>''<>''
      and pg_input_is_valid(s.value,'')
  ),
  values_by_chunk as materialized (
    select m.chunk_id,count(*)::integer source_count,
      round(sum(coalesce(tf.total_pay_ex_vat,0)),2) expected_pay_ex_vat,

            then(s.payload_json->>'')::date end,
          s.week_ending_date::date))
        order by s.chunk_id,s.timesheet_id)
      from source_rows_base s
    ),''::jsonb)) v
    order by v.source_member_key
  ),
  source_rows as materialized (
    select s.*,v.vat_rate
    from source_rows_base s
    join vat_policy v on v.source_member_key=s.source_member_key and v.valid
  ),
  source_timesheet_ancestry(
    planned_invoice_id,
    root_timesheet_id,
    source_timesheet_id,
    ancestry_path,
    ancestry_depth
  ) as materialized (
    select distinct s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id,s.timesheet_id,
      array[s.timesheet_id]::uuid[],0
    from source_rows s
    union all
    select a.planned_invoice_id,a.root_timesheet_id,t.parent_timesheet_id,
      a.ancestry_path||t.parent_timesheet_id,a.ancestry_depth+1
    from source_timesheet_ancestry a
    join public.timesheets t
      on t.timesheet_id=a.source_timesheet_id
     and t.is_current
    where t.parent_timesheet_id is not null
      and not(t.parent_timesheet_id=any(a.ancestry_path))
      and a.ancestry_depth<32
  ),
  adjustment_segment_refs as materialized (
    select distinct s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id root_timesheet_id,
      coalesce(
        (s.payload_json#>>'')::boolean,
        true
      ) healthroster_attach_allowed,
      nullif(btrim(seg.value->>''),'') ref_num,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(
          seg.value->>'','')
        then(seg.value->>'')::timestamptz end start_utc,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(
          seg.value->>'','')
        then(seg.value->>'')::timestamptz end end_utc,
      lower(coalesce(seg.value->>'','')) in(
        '','','','') is_reversal
    from source_rows s
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(
      case when jsonb_typeof(s.invoice_breakdown_json->'')=''
        then s.invoice_breakdown_json->'' else ''::jsonb end)
      seg(value)
    where s.basis::text in('','')
  ),
  segment_lock_targets_pre as materialized (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      '',s.planned_invoice_id,
      '',s.timesheet_id,
      '',to_jsonb(p.segment_ids),
      '',encode(digest(jsonb_build_object(
        '',s.id,
        '',s.timesheet_version,
        '',s.updated_at,
        '',s.basis,
        '',s.invoice_breakdown_json
      )::text,''),''))
      order by s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id),''::jsonb) targets
    from source_rows s
    join selected_segments p
      on p.chunk_id=s.chunk_id and p.timesheet_id=s.timesheet_id
    where cardinality(coalesce(p.segment_ids,array[]::text[]))>0
      and exists(
        select 1
        from public.invoices existing_header
        where existing_header.id=s.planned_invoice_id)
  ),
  segment_lock_authority_pre as materialized (
    select r.*
    from segment_lock_targets_pre t
    cross join lateral private._invoice_segment_lock_batch(t.targets,v_now) r
  ),
  segment_lock_failures_pre as materialized (
    select * from segment_lock_authority_pre where not success
  ),
  segment_entries as materialized (
    select s.*,seg.ordinality,
      coalesce(nullif(seg.value->>'',''),
        left(encode(digest(seg.value::text,''),''),24)) segment_id,
      case when left(coalesce(seg.value->>'',''),10)
        ~ ''
        then left(seg.value->>'',10) end work_date,
      case when coalesce(seg.value->>'','')~
        '' then(seg.value->>'')::numeric
        else 0 end segment_hours_day,
      case when coalesce(seg.value->>'','')~
        '' then(seg.value->>'')::numeric
        else 0 end segment_hours_night,
      case when coalesce(seg.value->>'','')~
        '' then(seg.value->>'')::numeric
        else 0 end segment_hours_sat,
      case when coalesce(seg.value->>'','')~
        '' then(seg.value->>'')::numeric
        else 0 end segment_hours_sun,
      case when coalesce(seg.value->>'','')~
        '' then(seg.value->>'')::numeric
        else 0 end segment_hours_bh,
      case
        when coalesce(seg.value->>'','')~
          '' then(seg.value->>'')::numeric
        when coalesce(seg.value->>'','')~
          '' then(seg.value->>'')::numeric
        else 0 end segment_pay_ex,
      case
        when coalesce(seg.value->>'','')~
          '' then(seg.value->>'')::numeric
        when coalesce(seg.value->>'','')~
          '' then(seg.value->>'')::numeric
        else 0 end segment_charge_ex
    from (
      select distinct on (base.chunk_id,base.timesheet_id) base.*
      from source_rows base
      order by base.chunk_id,base.timesheet_id,base.source_member_key
    ) s
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(
      case when jsonb_typeof(s.invoice_breakdown_json->'')=''
        then s.invoice_breakdown_json->'' else ''::jsonb end)
      with ordinality seg(value,ordinality)
    where upper(coalesce(s.invoice_breakdown_json->>'',''))=''
      and nullif(seg.value->>'','') is null
      and exists(
        select 1 from selected_segments picked
        where picked.chunk_id=s.chunk_id
          and picked.timesheet_id=s.timesheet_id
          and coalesce(nullif(seg.value->>'',''),
            left(encode(digest(seg.value::text,''),''),24))
            =any(coalesce(picked.segment_ids,array[]::text[])))
  ),
  segment_daily_lines as materialized (
    select s.chunk_id,s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id,s.booking_id,
      s.candidate_display,s.week_ending_date,s.work_date,
      sum(s.segment_hours_day) h_day,sum(s.segment_hours_night) h_night,
      sum(s.segment_hours_sat) h_sat,sum(s.segment_hours_sun) h_sun,
      sum(s.segment_hours_bh) h_bh,sum(s.segment_pay_ex) pay_ex,
      sum(s.segment_charge_ex) charge_ex,max(s.vat_rate) vat_rate,
      max(s.charge_day) charge_day,max(s.charge_night) charge_night,
      max(s.charge_sat) charge_sat,max(s.charge_sun) charge_sun,
      max(s.charge_bh) charge_bh,
      max(s.timesheet_version) timesheet_version,
      (array_agg(s.id order by s.id))[1] tsfin_id,
      max(s.contract_role) contract_role,
      max(s.contract_display_site) contract_display_site,
      max(s.contract_ward_hint) contract_ward_hint,
      (array_agg(s.bucket_labels_json order by s.ordinality))[1]
        bucket_labels_json
    from segment_entries s
    where s.daily_calc_of_invoices and s.work_date is not null
    group by s.chunk_id,s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id,s.booking_id,
      s.candidate_display,s.week_ending_date,s.work_date
  ),
  segment_weekly_lines as materialized (
    select s.chunk_id,s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id,s.booking_id,
      s.candidate_display,s.week_ending_date,
      sum(s.segment_hours_day) h_day,sum(s.segment_hours_night) h_night,
      sum(s.segment_hours_sat) h_sat,sum(s.segment_hours_sun) h_sun,
      sum(s.segment_hours_bh) h_bh,sum(s.segment_pay_ex) pay_ex,
      sum(s.segment_charge_ex) charge_ex,max(s.vat_rate) vat_rate,
      max(s.charge_day) charge_day,max(s.charge_night) charge_night,
      max(s.charge_sat) charge_sat,max(s.charge_sun) charge_sun,
      max(s.charge_bh) charge_bh,
      max(s.timesheet_version) timesheet_version,
      (array_agg(s.id order by s.id))[1] tsfin_id,
      max(s.contract_role) contract_role,
      max(s.contract_display_site) contract_display_site,
      max(s.contract_ward_hint) contract_ward_hint,
      (array_agg(s.bucket_labels_json order by s.ordinality))[1]
        bucket_labels_json
    from segment_entries s
    where not s.daily_calc_of_invoices
       or not exists(select 1 from segment_entries d
         where d.chunk_id=s.chunk_id and d.timesheet_id=s.timesheet_id
           and d.daily_calc_of_invoices and d.work_date is not null)
    group by s.chunk_id,s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id,s.booking_id,
      s.candidate_display,s.week_ending_date
  ),
  nonsegment_lines as materialized (
    select s.chunk_id,s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id,s.booking_id,s.candidate_display,s.week_ending_date,
      coalesce(s.hours_day,0) h_day,coalesce(s.hours_night,0) h_night,coalesce(s.hours_sat,0) h_sat,
      coalesce(s.hours_sun,0) h_sun,coalesce(s.hours_bh,0) h_bh,
      round(coalesce(s.total_pay_ex_vat,0)-coalesce(s.additional_pay_ex_vat,0)
        -coalesce(s.expenses_pay_ex_vat,0)-coalesce(s.mileage_pay_ex_vat,0),2) pay_ex,
      round(coalesce(s.total_charge_ex_vat,0)-coalesce(s.additional_charge_ex_vat,0)
        -coalesce(s.expenses_charge_ex_vat,0)-coalesce(s.mileage_charge_ex_vat,0),2) charge_ex,
      s.vat_rate,s.charge_day,s.charge_night,s.charge_sat,s.charge_sun,
      s.charge_bh,s.timesheet_version,s.id tsfin_id,s.contract_role,
      s.contract_display_site,s.contract_ward_hint,s.bucket_labels_json
    from source_rows s
    where upper(coalesce(s.invoice_breakdown_json->>'',''))<>''
       or jsonb_array_length(case when jsonb_typeof(s.invoice_breakdown_json->'')=''
                                  then s.invoice_breakdown_json->'' else ''::jsonb end)=0
  ),
  additional_daily_lines as materialized (
    select s.chunk_id,s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id,s.booking_id,
      s.candidate_display,s.week_ending_date,upper(a.key) code,
      left(d.key,10) work_date,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(d.value,'')
        then d.value::numeric else 0 end units,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
        then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end pay_rate,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
        then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end charge_rate,
      round((case when pg_input_is_valid(d.value,'')
          then d.value::numeric else 0 end)*
        (case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
          then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end),2) pay_ex,
      round((case when pg_input_is_valid(d.value,'')
          then d.value::numeric else 0 end)*
        (case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
          then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end),2) charge_ex,
      coalesce(nullif(a.value->>'',''),a.key) bucket_name,
      coalesce(nullif(a.value->>'',''),'') unit_name,
      a.value->'' frequency,s.vat_rate,
      s.charge_day,s.charge_night,s.charge_sat,s.charge_sun,s.charge_bh,
      s.timesheet_version,s.id tsfin_id,s.contract_role,
      s.contract_display_site,s.contract_ward_hint,s.bucket_labels_json
    from source_rows s
    cross join lateral jsonb_each(
      case when jsonb_typeof(s.additional_units_json)=''
        then s.additional_units_json else ''::jsonb end) a
    cross join lateral jsonb_each_text(
      case when jsonb_typeof(a.value->'')=''
        then a.value->'' else ''::jsonb end) d
    where s.daily_calc_of_invoices
      and left(d.key,10) ~ ''
      and exists(select 1 from segment_entries se
        where se.chunk_id=s.chunk_id and se.timesheet_id=s.timesheet_id
          and se.work_date is not null)
  ),
  additional_weekly_lines as materialized (
    select s.chunk_id,s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id,s.booking_id,s.candidate_display,s.week_ending_date,
      upper(a.key) code,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
        then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end units,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
        then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end pay_rate,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
        then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end charge_rate,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
        then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end pay_ex,
      case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
        then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end charge_ex,
      coalesce(nullif(a.value->>'',''),a.key) bucket_name,
      coalesce(nullif(a.value->>'',''),'') unit_name,
      a.value->'' frequency,s.vat_rate,
      s.charge_day,s.charge_night,s.charge_sat,s.charge_sun,s.charge_bh,
      s.timesheet_version,s.id tsfin_id,s.contract_role,
      s.contract_display_site,s.contract_ward_hint,s.bucket_labels_json
    from source_rows s cross join lateral jsonb_each(
      case when jsonb_typeof(s.additional_units_json)=''
        then s.additional_units_json else ''::jsonb end) a
    where jsonb_typeof(a.value)=''
      and ((case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
              then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end)<>0
        or (case when pg_input_is_valid(a.value->>'','')
              then(a.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end)<>0)
      and not(s.daily_calc_of_invoices
        and jsonb_typeof(a.value->'')=''
        and exists(select 1 from jsonb_each_text(
          case when jsonb_typeof(a.value->'')=''
            then a.value->'' else ''::jsonb end) d
          where left(d.key,10) ~ ''))
  ),
  expense_lines as materialized (
    select s.chunk_id,s.planned_invoice_id,s.timesheet_id,s.booking_id,s.candidate_display,s.week_ending_date,
      e.code,e.pay_ex,e.charge_ex,s.vat_rate,s.expenses_description,

      s.charge_day,s.charge_night,s.charge_sat,s.charge_sun,s.charge_bh,
      s.timesheet_version,s.id tsfin_id,s.contract_role,
      s.contract_display_site,s.contract_ward_hint,s.bucket_labels_json
    from source_rows s
    cross join lateral (
      values
       ('',coalesce(s.travel_pay_ex_vat,0),coalesce(s.travel_charge_ex_vat,0)),
       ('',coalesce(s.accommodation_pay_ex_vat,0),coalesce(s.accommodation_charge_ex_vat,0)),
       ('',coalesce(s.other_pay_ex_vat,0),coalesce(s.other_charge_ex_vat,0)),
       ('',
          case when coalesce(s.travel_pay_ex_vat,0)+coalesce(s.accommodation_pay_ex_vat,0)+coalesce(s.other_pay_ex_vat,0)=0 then coalesce(s.expenses_pay_ex_vat,0) else 0 end,
          case when coalesce(s.travel_charge_ex_vat,0)+coalesce(s.accommodation_charge_ex_vat,0)+coalesce(s.other_charge_ex_vat,0)=0 then coalesce(s.expenses_charge_ex_vat,0) else 0 end),
       ('',coalesce(s.mileage_pay_ex_vat,0),coalesce(s.mileage_charge_ex_vat,0))

      null::numeric,null::numeric,null::numeric,null::numeric,null::numeric,

      null::numeric,null::numeric,null::numeric,null::numeric,null::numeric,
      charge_day,charge_night,charge_sat,charge_sun,charge_bh,
      pay_ex,charge_ex,vat_rate,'',
      ''||timesheet_id||''||code||'',

        '',contract_role,'',contract_display_site,
        '',contract_ward_hint,'',bucket_labels_json,
        '',jsonb_build_object('',code,'',bucket_name,
          '',unit_name,'',frequency),
        '',jsonb_build_object('',units,'',pay_rate,

      case when code='' then ''||coalesce(mileage_units,0)||

        else initcap(replace(code,'',''))||''||week_ending_date||'' end,
      0,0,0,0,0,
      null::numeric,null::numeric,null::numeric,null::numeric,null::numeric,
      charge_day,charge_night,charge_sat,charge_sun,charge_bh,
      pay_ex,charge_ex,vat_rate,
      case when code='' then ''
        when code='' then ''
        else ''||code end,
      case when code='' then ''||timesheet_id||''
        when code='' then ''||timesheet_id||''

  correction_scopes_pre as materialized (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(

      '',scope.planned_invoice_id::text,
      '',case when exists(select 1 from public.invoices existing

      '',scope.payload_json->>'',
      '',scope.payload_json->>'',

  correction_validation_pre as materialized (

  ),
  correction_failures_pre as materialized (

  ),  write_eligible_chunks as materialized (
    select vc.*

      where f.scope_key=vc.planned_invoice_id::text)
  ),
  line_totals as materialized (
    select l.planned_invoice_id,
      round(sum(round(l.charge_ex,2)),2) subtotal_ex_vat,
      round(sum(round(l.charge_ex*l.vat_rate/100,2)),2) vat_amount,

  existing_target_headers as materialized (

  inserted_headers as (

    select h.planned_invoice_id,h.client_id,'',v_now,
      t.subtotal_ex_vat,t.vat_amount,t.total_inc_vat,
      jsonb_build_object('',h.client_id,'',h.client_name)
      ||case when private._candidate_feature_enabled_current_v1('')
