      ||jsonb_build_object(
        '',h.client_invoice_address,'',h.primary_invoice_email,
        '',h.agency_name,'',h.agency_logo,'',h.registered_address,
        '',h.company_reg_number,'',h.company_reg_number,
        '',h.vat_chargeable,'',h.payment_terms_days,
        '',null,'',null,
        '',jsonb_build_object(
          '',t.subtotal_ex_vat,
          '',t.vat_amount,'',t.total_inc_vat),
        '',jsonb_build_object('',h.bank_name,'',h.bank_sort_code,'',h.bank_account_number),
        '',h.vat_registration_number,
        '',jsonb_build_object('','',
          '',vc.payload_json->>'',
          '',vc.payload_json->>'',
          '',vc.payload_json->>''='','',h.source_count)
          ||case when private._candidate_feature_enabled_current_v1('')
            then jsonb_build_object('',upper(coalesce(vc.payload_json->>'','')))
            else ''::jsonb end,
        '',vc.payload_json#>''),
      1,'',v_now,v_now
    from header_source h join write_eligible_chunks vc on vc.id=h.chunk_id
    join line_totals t on t.planned_invoice_id=h.planned_invoice_id
    where not exists(
      select 1 from segment_lock_failures_pre f
      where f.invoice_id=h.planned_invoice_id)
    on conflict(id) do nothing returning id
  ),
  target_headers as materialized (
    select e.chunk_id,e.invoice_id
    from existing_target_headers e
    where not exists(
      select 1
      from inserted_headers h
      where h.id=e.invoice_id)
  ),
  deferred_new_headers as (
    update public.invoice_operation_chunks c
    set status='',
      phase='',
      progress_json=coalesce(c.progress_json,''::jsonb)
        ||jsonb_build_object('',
          ''),
      error_json=null,
      lease_owner=null,
      lease_token=null,
      lease_expires_at_utc=null,
      updated_at_utc=v_now
    from inserted_headers h
    join write_eligible_chunks vc on vc.planned_invoice_id=h.id
    where c.id=vc.id
    returning c.id
  ),
  inserted_lines as (
    insert into public.invoice_lines(
      invoice_id,timesheet_id,booking_id,description,hours_day,hours_night,hours_sat,hours_sun,hours_bh,
      pay_day,pay_night,pay_sat,pay_sun,pay_bh,
      charge_day,charge_night,charge_sat,charge_sun,charge_bh,
      total_pay_ex_vat,total_charge_ex_vat,margin_ex_vat,vat_rate_pct,vat_amount,total_inc_vat,
      paper_ts_r2_key,meta_json,source_key
    )
    select l.planned_invoice_id,l.timesheet_id,l.booking_id,l.description,
      round(l.h_day,2),round(l.h_night,2),round(l.h_sat,2),round(l.h_sun,2),round(l.h_bh,2),
      l.pay_day,l.pay_night,l.pay_sat,l.pay_sun,l.pay_bh,
      l.charge_day,l.charge_night,l.charge_sat,l.charge_sun,l.charge_bh,
      round(l.pay_ex,2),round(l.charge_ex,2),round(l.charge_ex-l.pay_ex,2),l.vat_rate,
      round(l.charge_ex*l.vat_rate/100,2),round(l.charge_ex+(l.charge_ex*l.vat_rate/100),2),
      null,jsonb_build_object('',l.line_type,'',l.timesheet_id,
        '',l.description,'',
        (select s.week_ending_date from source_rows s where s.timesheet_id=l.timesheet_id limit 1),
        '',
        (select s.schedule_refs from source_rows s where s.timesheet_id=l.timesheet_id limit 1),
        '',jsonb_build_object('',round(l.pay_ex,2),
          '',round(l.charge_ex,2),'',round(l.charge_ex-l.pay_ex,2),
          '',l.vat_rate,'',round(l.charge_ex*l.vat_rate/100,2),
          '',round(l.charge_ex+(l.charge_ex*l.vat_rate/100),2)))||l.detail,l.source_key
    from line_union l join target_headers h on h.invoice_id=l.planned_invoice_id
    on conflict(invoice_id,source_key) do nothing
    returning invoice_id,timesheet_id,total_charge_ex_vat,vat_amount,total_inc_vat
  ),
  all_target_lines as materialized (
    select l.invoice_id,l.total_charge_ex_vat,l.vat_amount,l.total_inc_vat
    from public.invoice_lines l
    where l.invoice_id in(select invoice_id from target_headers)
    union all
    select l.invoice_id,l.total_charge_ex_vat,l.vat_amount,l.total_inc_vat
    from inserted_lines l
  ),
  all_line_totals as materialized (
    select l.invoice_id,count(*)::integer line_count,
      round(sum(l.total_charge_ex_vat),2) subtotal_ex_vat,
      round(sum(l.vat_amount),2) vat_amount,
      round(sum(l.total_inc_vat),2) total_inc_vat
    from all_target_lines l
    group by l.invoice_id
  ),
  target_header_streams as materialized (
    select h.invoice_id,
      max(upper(coalesce(c.payload_json->>'',''))) invoice_stream
    from target_headers h
    join public.invoice_operation_chunks c on c.id=h.chunk_id
    group by h.invoice_id
  ),
  updated_header_totals as (
    update public.invoices i
    set subtotal_ex_vat=t.subtotal_ex_vat,vat_amount=t.vat_amount,
      total_inc_vat=t.total_inc_vat,document_state='',
      header_snapshot_json=coalesce(i.header_snapshot_json,''::jsonb)
        ||jsonb_build_object('',jsonb_build_object(
          '',t.subtotal_ex_vat,'',t.vat_amount,
          '',t.total_inc_vat))
        ||case when private._candidate_feature_enabled_current_v1('')
          then jsonb_build_object(
            '',s.invoice_stream,
            '',coalesce(i.header_snapshot_json->'',''::jsonb)
              ||jsonb_build_object('',s.invoice_stream))
          else ''::jsonb end,
      updated_at=v_now
    from all_line_totals t
    join target_header_streams s on s.invoice_id=t.invoice_id
    where i.id=t.invoice_id
    returning i.id
  ),
  segment_lock_targets as materialized (
    select targets from segment_lock_targets_pre
  ),
  segment_lock_authority as materialized (
    select * from segment_lock_authority_pre
  ),
  segment_lock_failures as materialized (
    select * from segment_lock_authority where not success
  ),
  whole_lock as (
    update public.timesheets_financials tf
    set locked_by_invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id,locked_at_utc=v_now,updated_at=v_now
    from members m join write_eligible_chunks vc on vc.id=m.chunk_id
    join target_headers h
      on h.chunk_id=vc.id and h.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id
    cross join (select count(*) applied_count from segment_lock_authority) segment_application
    where tf.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id and tf.is_current
      and (coalesce(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->>'','')<>''
        or not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'',''::jsonb)) e
                      where nullif(e->>'','') is null))
    returning tf.timesheet_id
  ),
  week_lock as (
    update public.contract_weeks cw set status='',updated_at=v_now
    where cw.timesheet_id in(
      select m.timesheet_id
      from members m
      join target_headers h on h.chunk_id=m.chunk_id)
      and exists(select 1 from public.timesheets_financials tf where tf.timesheet_id=cw.timesheet_id
        and tf.is_current and (tf.locked_by_invoice_id is not null or
          not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'',''::jsonb)) e
                     where nullif(e->>'','') is null)))
    returning cw.id
  ),
  nhsp_shift_inclusion as (
    update public.nhsp_shifts ns
    set invoice_status='',
      invoice_id=h.invoice_id,
      updated_at=v_now
    from source_rows s
    join target_headers h
      on h.chunk_id=s.chunk_id and h.invoice_id=s.planned_invoice_id
    where ns.timesheet_id=s.timesheet_id
      and ns.invoice_status=''
      and ns.invoice_id is null
      and ns.cancelled_at_utc is null
      and exists(
        select 1
        from jsonb_array_elements(
          case when jsonb_typeof(s.invoice_breakdown_json->'')=''
            then s.invoice_breakdown_json->''
            else ''::jsonb end) segment(value)
        where coalesce(
            nullif(segment.value->>'',''),
            nullif(segment.value->>'',''))=ns.id::text)
    returning ns.id
  ),
  hr_member_sources as materialized (
    select distinct h.invoice_id,m.timesheet_id,
      case when tf.basis::text in('','')
        then '' else '' end source_system,
      tf.nhsp_import_id import_id,
      case when jsonb_typeof(tf.external_source_rows_json)=''
        then tf.external_source_rows_json else ''::jsonb end member_rows
    from members m
    join target_headers h on h.chunk_id=m.chunk_id
    join public.timesheets_financials tf on tf.timesheet_id=m.timesheet_id and tf.is_current
    where tf.nhsp_import_id is not null
  ),
  hr_sources as (
    insert into public.invoice_hr_source_rows(
      invoice_id,source_system,import_id,header_columns,rows_json,header_rows,member_rows_json)
    select m.invoice_id,m.source_system,m.import_id,''::jsonb,
      coalesce((select jsonb_agg(rows.value order by rows.value::text)
        from (select distinct r.value from hr_member_sources same_source
          cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(same_source.member_rows) r(value)
          where same_source.invoice_id=m.invoice_id and same_source.source_system=m.source_system
            and same_source.import_id=m.import_id) rows),''::jsonb),
      ''::jsonb,jsonb_object_agg(m.timesheet_id::text,m.member_rows order by m.timesheet_id)
    from hr_member_sources m group by m.invoice_id,m.source_system,m.import_id
    on conflict(invoice_id,source_system,import_id) do update
      set member_rows_json=invoice_hr_source_rows.member_rows_json||excluded.member_rows_json,
        rows_json=coalesce((select jsonb_agg(rows.value order by rows.value::text)
          from(select distinct r.value from jsonb_array_elements(
            invoice_hr_source_rows.rows_json||excluded.rows_json) r(value)) rows),''::jsonb)
    returning invoice_id
  ),
  source_segments as materialized (
    select distinct h.invoice_id planned_invoice_id,
      coalesce(
        case when coalesce(x.value->>'','')~*
            ''
          then(x.value->>'')::uuid end,
        case when coalesce(x.value->>'','')~*
            ''
          then(x.value->>'')::uuid end,
        case when substr(coalesce(x.value->>'',''),6)~*
            ''
          then substr(x.value->>'',6)::uuid end) shift_id,
      case
        when s.basis::text in('','')
         and (
           lower(coalesce(x.value->>'','')) in(
             '','','','')
           or coalesce(s.total_hours,0)<0
         ) then ''
        when s.basis::text in('','')
          then ''
        else ''
      end evidence_role_key
    from source_rows s
    join target_headers h
      on h.chunk_id=s.chunk_id and h.invoice_id=s.planned_invoice_id
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(
      case when jsonb_typeof(s.invoice_breakdown_json->'')=''
        then s.invoice_breakdown_json->'' else ''::jsonb end) x(value)
    where coalesce(
        nullif(x.value->>'',''),
        nullif(x.value->>'',''),
        case when left(x.value->>'',5)=''
          then substr(x.value->>'',6) end)~*
      ''
      and (
        upper(coalesce(x.value->>'',''))=''
        or (upper(coalesce(x.value->>'',''))=''
          and coalesce((s.payload_json#>>'')::boolean,true)))
    union
    select distinct r.planned_invoice_id,n.id shift_id,
      case when r.is_reversal then ''
        else '' end evidence_role_key
    from adjustment_segment_refs r
    join source_timesheet_ancestry a
      on a.planned_invoice_id=r.planned_invoice_id
     and a.root_timesheet_id=r.root_timesheet_id
     and a.ancestry_depth>0
    join public.nhsp_shifts n
      on n.timesheet_id=a.source_timesheet_id
     and n.latest_import_id is not null
     and n.external_row_key is not null
     and (
       upper(coalesce(n.source_system::text,''))=''
       or (
         upper(coalesce(n.source_system::text,''))=''
         and r.healthroster_attach_allowed
       )
     )
     and (
       (r.ref_num is not null
         and btrim(coalesce(n.ref_num,''))=r.ref_num)
       or (
         r.ref_num is null
         and r.start_utc is not null
         and r.end_utc is not null
         and n.start_utc=r.start_utc
         and n.end_utc=r.end_utc
       )
     )
  ),
  source_import_rows as materialized (
    select distinct s.planned_invoice_id,
      upper(coalesce(n.source_system::text,'')) source_system,
      n.latest_import_id import_id,n.external_row_key,s.evidence_role_key
    from source_segments s
    join public.nhsp_shifts n on n.id=s.shift_id
    where n.latest_import_id is not null
      and n.external_row_key is not null
  ),
  source_imports as materialized (
    select s.planned_invoice_id,s.source_system,s.import_id,
      jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        '',s.external_row_key,
        '',s.evidence_role_key)
        order by s.external_row_key,s.evidence_role_key) row_occurrences
    from source_import_rows s
    group by s.planned_invoice_id,s.source_system,s.import_id
  ),
  authoritative_hr_sources as (
    insert into public.invoice_hr_source_rows(
      invoice_id,source_system,import_id,header_columns,rows_json)
    select g.planned_invoice_id,g.source_system,g.import_id,
      case when jsonb_typeof(i.parse_summary_json->'')=''
        then i.parse_summary_json->'' else ''::jsonb end,
      coalesce((select jsonb_agg(
          r.payload_json
            ||jsonb_build_object(
              '',case occurrence.value->>''
                when '' then case when g.source_system=''
                  then '' else '' end
                when '' then case when g.source_system=''
                  then '' else '' end
                else case when g.source_system=''
                  then '' else '' end
              end)
            ||case when occurrence.value->>''=''
              then jsonb_build_object('','')
              else ''::jsonb end
          order by r.id,occurrence.value->>'')
        from jsonb_array_elements(g.row_occurrences) occurrence(value)
        join public.hr_rows r
          on r.import_id=g.import_id
         and r.external_row_key=occurrence.value->>''),
        ''::jsonb)
    from source_imports g join public.hr_imports i on i.id=g.import_id
    on conflict(invoice_id,source_system,import_id) do update
      set header_columns=excluded.header_columns,rows_json=excluded.rows_json
    returning invoice_id
  ),
  audits as (
    insert into public.audit_events(ts_utc,actor_user_id,actor_display,actor_role_at_time,
      object_type,object_id_text,action,after_json,reason)
    select v_now,o.actor_user_id,u.display_name,u.role,'',vc.planned_invoice_id::text,
      case when exists(select 1 from inserted_headers h
        where h.id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
        then '' else '' end,
      jsonb_build_object('',vc.planned_invoice_id,
        '',coalesce(vc.payload_json->'',
          vc.payload_json->'',''::jsonb),
        '',vc.payload_json->>'',
        '',vc.operation_id),''
    from write_eligible_chunks vc
    join target_headers h
      on h.chunk_id=vc.id and h.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id
    join public.invoice_operations o on o.id=vc.operation_id
    left join public.tms_users u on u.id=o.actor_user_id
    where c.resume_invoice_id is null
    returning id
  ),
  correction_failures as materialized (
    select scope_key::uuid invoice_id,blocker_code,detail
    from correction_failures_pre
    where scope_key~*
      ''
  )
  update public.invoice_operation_chunks c
    set status=case when exists(select 1 from all_line_totals l
                               where l.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
          and not exists(select 1 from correction_failures cf
            where cf.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
          and not exists(select 1 from segment_lock_failures sf
            where sf.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
        then '' else '' end,
      phase=case when exists(select 1 from all_line_totals l
                            where l.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
          and not exists(select 1 from correction_failures cf
            where cf.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
          and not exists(select 1 from segment_lock_failures sf
            where sf.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
        then '' else '' end,
      result_json=jsonb_build_object('',jsonb_build_array(vc.planned_invoice_id),
        '',vc.payload_json->>''),
      error_json=case
        when not exists(select 1 from all_line_totals l
          where l.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
          then jsonb_build_object('','')
        when exists(select 1 from segment_lock_failures sf
          where sf.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
          then jsonb_build_object('','','',(
            select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(sf))
            from segment_lock_failures sf
            where sf.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id))
        when exists(select 1 from correction_failures cf
          where cf.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
          then jsonb_build_object('',(
            select cf.blocker_code from correction_failures cf
            where cf.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id))
        else null end,
      completed_at_utc=case
        when exists(select 1 from all_line_totals l
          where l.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
          and not exists(select 1 from correction_failures cf
            where cf.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
          and not exists(select 1 from segment_lock_failures sf
            where sf.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id)
        then v_now else null end,
      lease_owner=null,lease_token=null,lease_expires_at_utc=null,
      updated_at_utc=v_now
    from valid_chunks vc
    join target_headers h
      on h.chunk_id=vc.id and h.invoice_id=vc.planned_invoice_id
    cross join (select count(*) applied_count from segment_lock_authority) segment_application
    cross join (select count(*) cached_count from authoritative_hr_sources) source_cache_application
    where c.id=vc.id

perform i.id from public.invoices i
  where i.id in (select c.entity_id
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) x
    join public.invoice_operation_chunks c on c.id=(x->>'')::uuid
    where x->>''='' and c.payload_json->>''='')
  order by i.id for update

execute $q$
  with claim_ids as materialized (
    select (x->>'')::uuid chunk_id
    from jsonb_array_elements($1) x where x->>''=''
  ),
  credit_revisions as materialized (
    select c.*,i.id source_invoice_id,(c.payload_json#>>'')::uuid credit_note_id,
      own.credit_note_id resume_invoice_id,
      case when own.credit_note_id is null and exists(
        select 1 from public.invoices existing where existing.original_invoice_id=i.id
          and existing.type='' and existing.status in('','',''))
        then '' end coverage_blocker
      ,encode(digest(concat_ws('',i.id::text,i.updated_at::text,i.status::text,
        i.subtotal_ex_vat::text,i.vat_amount::text,i.total_inc_vat::text),
        ''),'') current_revision
    from claim_ids q join public.invoice_operation_chunks c on c.id=q.chunk_id
    join public.invoices i on i.id=c.entity_id
    left join lateral private._invoice_credit_resume_v1(i.id,c.operation_id,
      (c.payload_json#>>'')::uuid,null) own on true
    where c.payload_json->>''=''
      and i.type='' and i.status in ('','')
  ),
  credit_correction_scopes as materialized (
    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      '',''||c.source_invoice_id::text,
      '',c.source_invoice_id::text,
      '',c.source_invoice_id,
      '','')
      order by c.source_invoice_id),''::jsonb) scopes
    from(select distinct source_invoice_id from credit_revisions) c
  ),
  credit_correction_failures as materialized (
    select r.invoice_id source_invoice_id,r.blocker_code,r.detail_json
    from credit_correction_scopes s
    cross join lateral private._invoice_correction_validate_batch(
      s.scopes,($2 at time zone '')::date) r
    where not r.valid
  ),
  credit_rejected as (
    update public.invoice_operation_chunks q
    set status='',phase='',
      error_json=jsonb_build_object('',case
        when c.coverage_blocker is not null then c.coverage_blocker
        when c.resume_invoice_id is null and c.current_revision<>c.payload_json->>''
          then ''
        else coalesce((select f.blocker_code
          from credit_correction_failures f
          where f.source_invoice_id=c.source_invoice_id
          order by f.blocker_code limit 1),'')
        end),
      lease_owner=null,lease_token=null,lease_expires_at_utc=null,
      updated_at_utc=$2
    from credit_revisions c
    where q.id=c.id and(
      c.coverage_blocker is not null
      or (c.resume_invoice_id is null and c.current_revision<>c.payload_json->>'')
      or (c.resume_invoice_id is null and exists(select 1 from credit_correction_failures f
        where f.source_invoice_id=c.source_invoice_id)))
    returning q.id
  ),
  credits as materialized (
    select c.* from credit_revisions c
    where (c.resume_invoice_id is not null or c.current_revision=c.payload_json->>'')
      and c.coverage_blocker is null and not exists(select 1 from credit_rejected r where r.id=c.id)
  ),
  inserted_credit as (
    insert into public.invoices(id,type,client_id,status,status_date_utc,subtotal_ex_vat,vat_amount,total_inc_vat,
      original_invoice_id,notes,header_snapshot_json,document_revision,document_state,created_at,updated_at)
    select c.credit_note_id,'',i.client_id,'',$2,
      -i.subtotal_ex_vat,-i.vat_amount,-i.total_inc_vat,i.id,
      c.payload_json->>'',
      i.header_snapshot_json||jsonb_build_object(
        '',i.id,'',c.operation_id,
        '',c.payload_json->>''),1,'',$2,$2
    from credits c join public.invoices i on i.id=c.source_invoice_id
    where c.resume_invoice_id is null
    on conflict(id) do nothing returning id
  ),
  cloned_lines as (
    insert into public.invoice_lines(invoice_id,timesheet_id,booking_id,description,
      hours_day,hours_night,hours_sat,hours_sun,hours_bh,pay_day,pay_night,pay_sat,pay_sun,pay_bh,
      charge_day,charge_night,charge_sat,charge_sun,charge_bh,total_pay_ex_vat,total_charge_ex_vat,
      margin_ex_vat,vat_rate_pct,vat_amount,total_inc_vat,paper_ts_r2_key,meta_json,source_key)
    select c.credit_note_id,l.timesheet_id,l.booking_id,
      ''||coalesce(l.description,''),
      l.hours_day,l.hours_night,l.hours_sat,l.hours_sun,l.hours_bh,
      l.pay_day,l.pay_night,l.pay_sat,l.pay_sun,l.pay_bh,
      l.charge_day,l.charge_night,l.charge_sat,l.charge_sun,l.charge_bh,
      -l.total_pay_ex_vat,-l.total_charge_ex_vat,-l.margin_ex_vat,l.vat_rate_pct,
      -l.vat_amount,-l.total_inc_vat,l.paper_ts_r2_key,
      coalesce(l.meta_json,''::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object(
        '',true,'',c.source_invoice_id,
        '',l.id,'',l.id,'',
        ''||coalesce(l.meta_json->>'','')),
      ''||c.credit_note_id||''||l.id
    from credits c join public.invoice_lines l on l.invoice_id=c.source_invoice_id
    where c.resume_invoice_id is null
    on conflict(invoice_id,source_key) do nothing returning invoice_id
  ),
  source_mark as (
    update public.invoices i set credit_note_created_at_utc=$2,updated_at=$2
    where i.id in(select source_invoice_id from credits where resume_invoice_id is null) returning i.id
  ),
  
  unlocks as (
    update public.timesheets_financials tf
    set locked_by_invoice_id=case when tf.locked_by_invoice_id=c.source_invoice_id
          then null else tf.locked_by_invoice_id end,
      locked_at_utc=case when tf.locked_by_invoice_id=c.source_invoice_id
          then null else tf.locked_at_utc end,
      invoice_breakdown_json=case when jsonb_typeof(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'')=''
        then jsonb_set(tf.invoice_breakdown_json,'',coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(case when e.value->>''=c.source_invoice_id::text
            then(e.value-''-'') else e.value end order by e.ordinality)
          from jsonb_array_elements(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'') with ordinality e(value,ordinality)
        ),''::jsonb),true) else tf.invoice_breakdown_json end,
      unlocked_by_credit_note_id=c.credit_note_id,is_stale=true,
      stale_reason='',updated_at=$2
    from credits c
    where c.resume_invoice_id is null and tf.is_current and (
      tf.locked_by_invoice_id=c.source_invoice_id
      or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(case
        when jsonb_typeof(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'')=''
        then tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'' else ''::jsonb end) e
        where e->>''=c.source_invoice_id::text))
    returning tf.timesheet_id
  ),
  segment_unlocks as materialized (select timesheet_id from unlocks),
  recompute_outbox as (
    insert into public.ts_financials_outbox(
      timesheet_id,reason,attempt_count,next_attempt_at,last_error,created_at)
    select distinct u.timesheet_id,''::public.ts_fin_reason_enum,
      0,$2,null,$2
    from (
      select timesheet_id from unlocks
      union all select timesheet_id from segment_unlocks
    ) u
    on conflict on constraint uq_tsfin_outbox do nothing
    returning timesheet_id
  ),
  credit_audits as (
    insert into public.audit_events(ts_utc,actor_user_id,actor_display,
      actor_role_at_time,object_type,object_id_text,action,after_json,reason)
    select $2,o.actor_user_id,u.display_name,u.role,'',
      c.credit_note_id::text,'',
      jsonb_build_object('',c.credit_note_id,
        '',c.source_invoice_id,
        '',c.payload_json->>'',
        '',c.payload_json->>'',
        '',-i.subtotal_ex_vat,'',-i.vat_amount,
        '',-i.total_inc_vat,
        '',true),
      ''
    from credits c join public.invoices i on i.id=c.source_invoice_id
    join public.invoice_operations o on o.id=c.operation_id
    left join public.tms_users u on u.id=o.actor_user_id
    returning id
  ),
  completed as (
    update public.invoice_operation_chunks q
    set status='',
      phase='',
      error_json=null,
      completed_at_utc=null,lease_owner=null,lease_token=null,
      lease_expires_at_utc=null,updated_at_utc=$2,
      result_json=jsonb_build_object('',jsonb_build_array(c.credit_note_id),
        '',c.credit_note_id,'',c.source_invoice_id)
    from credits c
    cross join (select count(*) outbox_count from recompute_outbox) outbox_application
    cross join (select count(*) audit_count from credit_audits) audit_application
    where q.id=c.id
    returning q.id,q.status,q.phase,q.result_json,q.error_json
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    '',id,'',status,'',phase,
    '',result_json,'',error_json)),''::jsonb)
  from completed
  $q$
  into v_part using p_claims,v_now

with claim_ids as materialized (
    select (x->>'')::uuid chunk_id
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) x where x->>''=''
  ),
  queued_sources as materialized (
    select c.id chunk_id,c.operation_id parent_operation_id,
      (c.payload_json#>>'')::uuid planned_invoice_id,
      c.payload_json->>'' source_revision,
      c.payload_json->>'' command_type,
      c.payload_json->>'' command_token,
      c.payload_json->>'' credit_reason,
      i.document_revision::text document_revision
    from claim_ids q join public.invoice_operation_chunks c on c.id=q.chunk_id
    join public.invoices i
      on i.id=(c.payload_json#>>'')::uuid
    where c.payload_json->>''<>'' or i.status=''
  ),
  existing_doc_versions as materialized (
    select distinct on(q.chunk_id) q.chunk_id,v.id document_version_id,
      v.operation_id,v.status
    from queued_sources q
    join public.invoice_document_versions v
      on v.entity_type=''
     and v.entity_id=q.planned_invoice_id
     and v.purpose=''
     and v.source_revision=q.document_revision
     and v.template_version=''
     and v.status in(
       '','','','',
       '','')
    where q.command_type<>''
    order by q.chunk_id,case when v.status='' then 0 else 1 end,
      v.created_at_utc desc,v.id desc
  ),
  doc_ops as materialized (
    insert into public.invoice_operations(parent_operation_id,operation_type,entity_type,entity_id,actor_user_id,
      idempotency_key,status,phase,priority,source_revision,template_version,input_json,config_json,progress_json,
      total_units,chunk_count,control_version,change_seq,created_at_utc,updated_at_utc)
    select q.parent_operation_id,'','',q.planned_invoice_id,o.actor_user_id,
      encode(digest(''||q.planned_invoice_id||''||q.document_revision||
        '',''),''),
      '','',550,q.document_revision,'',
      jsonb_build_object('',q.planned_invoice_id,'',''),
      jsonb_build_object('',o.config_json->''),
      '',1,1,1,
      nextval(''),v_now,v_now
    from queued_sources q join public.invoice_operations o on o.id=q.parent_operation_id
    where q.command_type<>''
      and not exists(
        select 1 from existing_doc_versions e where e.chunk_id=q.chunk_id)
    on conflict(idempotency_key) where status in ('','','','','')
    do update set priority=greatest(invoice_operations.priority,excluded.priority),updated_at_utc=v_now
    returning *
  ),
  selected_doc_ops as materialized (
    select q.chunk_id,q.planned_invoice_id,q.document_revision source_revision,
      d.id operation_id,d.control_version,null::uuid existing_version_id,
      null::text existing_status
    from queued_sources q join doc_ops d on d.entity_id=q.planned_invoice_id
    union all
    select q.chunk_id,q.planned_invoice_id,q.document_revision,
      e.operation_id,o.control_version,e.document_version_id,e.status
    from queued_sources q
    join existing_doc_versions e on e.chunk_id=q.chunk_id
    join public.invoice_operations o on o.id=e.operation_id
  ),
  doc_versions as materialized (
    insert into public.invoice_document_versions(entity_type,entity_id,purpose,operation_id,source_revision,
      template_version,status,snapshot_json,snapshot_hash,manifest_json,manifest_hash,created_at_utc)
    select '',d.planned_invoice_id,'',d.operation_id,d.source_revision,
      '','','',encode(digest('',''),''),
      '',encode(digest('',''),''),v_now
    from selected_doc_ops d
    where d.existing_version_id is null
    on conflict(entity_type,entity_id,purpose,source_revision,template_version)
      where purpose in('','')
        and status in ('','','','','','')
    do nothing
    returning id,entity_id,operation_id
  ),
  all_doc_versions as materialized (
    select d.chunk_id,d.planned_invoice_id,d.operation_id,d.control_version,
      d.source_revision,
      coalesce(d.existing_version_id,v.id) document_version_id,
      coalesce(d.existing_status,'') document_status
    from selected_doc_ops d
    left join doc_versions v
      on v.entity_id=d.planned_invoice_id and v.operation_id=d.operation_id
    where d.existing_version_id is not null or v.id is not null
  ),
  doc_chunks as (
    insert into public.invoice_operation_chunks(operation_id,chunk_type,phase,work_key,sequence_no,entity_type,entity_id,
      document_version_id,status,priority,run_after_utc,payload_json,operation_control_version,created_at_utc,updated_at_utc)
    select d.operation_id,'','',
      encode(digest(concat_ws('','',d.document_version_id::text,
        d.source_revision,'',''),''),''),
      0,'',d.planned_invoice_id,d.document_version_id,
      '',550,v_now,jsonb_build_object('',''),d.control_version,v_now,v_now
    from all_doc_versions d
    where d.document_status<>''
    on conflict(operation_id,chunk_type,level_no,sequence_no,work_key) do nothing returning operation_id
  ),
  invoice_ptrs as (
    update public.invoices i set preview_document_version_id=d.document_version_id,
      active_document_operation_id=case when d.document_status=''
        then null else d.operation_id end,
      document_state=case when d.document_status=''
        then '' else '' end,updated_at=v_now
    from all_doc_versions d where i.id=d.planned_invoice_id returning i.id
  ),
  credit_issue_ops as materialized (
    insert into public.invoice_operations(
      parent_operation_id,operation_type,entity_type,entity_id,actor_user_id,
      idempotency_key,status,phase,priority,source_revision,template_version,
      input_json,config_json,progress_json,total_units,chunk_count,
      control_version,change_seq,created_at_utc,updated_at_utc)
    select q.parent_operation_id,'','',q.planned_invoice_id,
      o.actor_user_id,
      encode(digest(''||q.planned_invoice_id||''||
        q.parent_operation_id||''||coalesce(q.command_token,''),''),''),
      '','',850,q.document_revision,'',
      jsonb_build_object(
        '',jsonb_build_array(q.planned_invoice_id),
        '',true,'',q.credit_reason,
        '',q.command_token,'',false),
      jsonb_build_object('',o.config_json->''),
      '',1,1,1,nextval(''),v_now,v_now
    from queued_sources q
    join public.invoice_operations o on o.id=q.parent_operation_id
    where q.command_type=''
    on conflict(idempotency_key)
      where status in('','','','','')
    do update set priority=greatest(invoice_operations.priority,excluded.priority),
      updated_at_utc=v_now
    returning *
  ),
  selected_credit_issue as materialized (
    select q.chunk_id,q.planned_invoice_id,q.document_revision,
      q.command_token,q.credit_reason,o.id operation_id,o.control_version
    from queued_sources q
    join credit_issue_ops o on o.parent_operation_id=q.parent_operation_id
      and o.operation_type=''
    where q.command_type=''
  ),
  credit_issue_chunks as (
    insert into public.invoice_operation_chunks(
      operation_id,chunk_type,phase,work_key,sequence_no,entity_type,entity_id,status,
      priority,run_after_utc,payload_json,operation_control_version,
      created_at_utc,updated_at_utc)
    select s.operation_id,'','',
      encode(digest(concat_ws('','',s.planned_invoice_id::text,
        s.document_revision,s.command_token),''),''),
      0,'',
      s.planned_invoice_id,'',850,v_now,
      jsonb_build_object(
        '',s.planned_invoice_id,
        '',s.document_revision,
        '',true,'',false,
        '',s.command_token,
        '',true,'',s.credit_reason),
      s.control_version,v_now,v_now
    from selected_credit_issue s
    on conflict(operation_id,chunk_type,level_no,sequence_no,work_key) do nothing
    returning operation_id
  ),
  credit_issue_ptrs as (
    update public.invoices i
    set active_issue_operation_id=s.operation_id,issue_state='',
      updated_at=v_now
    from selected_credit_issue s
    where i.id=s.planned_invoice_id
    returning i.id
  ),
  child_results as materialized (
    select d.chunk_id,d.operation_id document_operation_id,
      d.document_version_id,null::uuid issue_operation_id
    from all_doc_versions d
    union all
    select s.chunk_id,null::uuid,null::uuid,s.operation_id
    from selected_credit_issue s
  )
  update public.invoice_operation_chunks c
    set status='',phase='',completed_at_utc=v_now,updated_at_utc=v_now,
      lease_owner=null,lease_token=null,lease_expires_at_utc=null,
      result_json=coalesce(c.result_json,''::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object(
        '',d.document_operation_id,
        '',d.document_version_id,
        '',d.issue_operation_id)
    from child_results d where c.id=d.chunk_id

update public.invoice_operation_chunks c
  set status='',phase='',completed_at_utc=v_now,updated_at_utc=v_now,
    lease_owner=null,lease_token=null,lease_expires_at_utc=null,error_json=null,
    result_json=coalesce(c.result_json,''::jsonb)||jsonb_build_object(
      '',i.id,'',d.id,'',true)
  from public.invoices i join public.invoice_document_versions d on d.id=i.issued_document_version_id
  where c.id in(select (x->>'')::uuid from jsonb_array_elements(p_claims) x
      where x->>''='')
    and c.payload_json->>''=''
    and i.id=(c.payload_json#>>'')::uuid
    and i.header_snapshot_json->>''=c.operation_id::text
    and i.type='' and i.status in('','')
    and d.entity_type='' and d.entity_id=i.id and d.purpose=''
    and d.status='' and d.verified_at_utc is not null
    and d.r2_key is not null and d.sha256 is not null and d.size_bytes>0 and d.page_count>0

routines.name: public.weekly_source_invoice_admit_atomic_v1
lockMutationStatements: perform 1 from public.weekly_source_groups where id=v_manifest.source_group_id for update
perform 1 from public.weekly_source_cycles where id in (v_manifest.source_cycle_id,coalesce(v_manifest.invoice_window_cycle_id,v_manifest.source_cycle_id)) order by id for update
select * into v_manifest from public.weekly_source_client_manifests where id=v_manifest_id for update

select * into strict v_revision from public.weekly_source_final_revisions
  where id=v_manifest.final_revision_id for share

select * into strict v_cycle from public.weekly_source_cycles
  where id=v_manifest.source_cycle_id for share

if v_manifest.movement_count=0 then
    update public.weekly_source_client_manifests set invoice_state=''
    where id=v_manifest.id and invoice_state=''
select * into strict v_client from public.clients where id=v_manifest.client_id for share
select * into strict v_defaults from public.settings_defaults where id=1 for share

if not (v_is_rounding and v_movement.candidate_id is null) then
    select * into strict v_contract from public.contracts
    where id=v_movement.contract_id and client_id=v_manifest.client_id
      and candidate_id=v_movement.candidate_id for share

select * into strict v_candidate from public.candidates
    where id=v_movement.candidate_id for share

insert into public.weekly_source_invoice_presentation_lines(
      billing_movement_id,client_manifest_id,final_revision_id,
      original_finalisation_cycle_id,line_kind,origin_kind,correction_root_id,
      correction_role,old_internal_movement_id,new_internal_movement_id,
      client_id,candidate_id,contract_id,work_event_id,source_shift_group_id,
      role_snapshot,band_snapshot,candidate_display_snapshot,client_display_snapshot,
      work_date,start_at_local,end_at_local,break_minutes,booking_reference_snapshot,
      description_snapshot,hours_day,hours_night,hours_sat,hours_sun,hours_bh,
      pay_day,pay_night,pay_sat,pay_sun,pay_bh,
      charge_day,charge_night,charge_sat,charge_sun,charge_bh,
      total_pay_ex_vat,total_charge_ex_vat,calculated_comparison_charge_pence,
      source_validation_charge_pence,invoice_presentation_charge_pence,
      margin_ex_vat,vat_rate_pct,vat_amount,total_inc_vat,price_check_result,
      price_check_profile,charge_acceptance_id,mapping_rate_policy_fingerprint,source_hash,
      amount_authority,presentation_hash,invoice_hold_release_id,invoice_rounding_authority_json,companion_presentation_line_id
    ) values (
      v_movement.id,v_manifest.id,v_manifest.final_revision_id,v_manifest.source_cycle_id,
      v_line_kind,v_origin_kind,v_movement.correction_unit_id,v_correction_role,
      v_old_id,v_new_id,v_manifest.client_id,v_movement.candidate_id,v_movement.contract_id,
      v_movement.work_event_id,v_movement.work_event_id,v_contract.role,v_contract.band,
      v_candidate_display,v_client_display,v_work_date,v_start,v_end,v_break,v_reference,
      v_description,v_hours_day,v_hours_night,v_hours_sat,v_hours_sun,v_hours_bh,
      v_pay_day,v_pay_night,v_pay_sat,v_pay_sun,v_pay_bh,
      v_charge_day,v_charge_night,v_charge_sat,v_charge_sun,v_charge_bh,
      v_total_pay,v_total_charge,v_calc_pence,v_source_pence,(v_total_charge*100)::bigint,
      v_total_charge-v_total_pay,v_vat_rate,v_vat,v_total,v_price_result,
      case when v_movement.source_profile_kind=''
        then '' when private.weekly_source_invoice_source_amount_movement_valid_v1(v_movement.id) then '' else null end,
      v_movement.charge_acceptance_id,
      v_mapping_fingerprint,v_source_hash,
      case when v_movement.source_profile_kind='' or v_is_expense
        or private.weekly_source_invoice_source_amount_movement_valid_v1(v_movement.id)
        then '' else '' end,
      v_presentation_hash,v_release_id,v_round_presentation,
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      case when v_is_expense then (
        select pg_catalog.min(shift_line.id::text)::uuid
        from public.weekly_source_invoice_presentation_lines shift_line
        where shift_line.client_manifest_id=v_manifest.id
          and shift_line.work_event_id=v_movement.work_event_id
          and shift_line.line_kind<>''
          and shift_line.correction_role is not distinct from v_correction_role
        having pg_catalog.count(*)=1
      ) end
    ) returning id into v_presentation_id

insert into public.invoice_lines(
      invoice_id,timesheet_id,booking_id,description,
      hours_day,hours_night,hours_sat,hours_sun,hours_bh,
      pay_day,pay_night,pay_sat,pay_sun,pay_bh,
      charge_day,charge_night,charge_sat,charge_sun,charge_bh,

      vat_amount,total_inc_vat,meta_json,source_key
    ) values (
      v_invoice_id,v_movement.invoice_timesheet_id,v_reference,v_description,
      v_hours_day,v_hours_night,v_hours_sat,v_hours_sun,v_hours_bh,
      v_pay_day,v_pay_night,v_pay_sat,v_pay_sun,v_pay_bh,
      v_charge_day,v_charge_night,v_charge_sat,v_charge_sun,v_charge_bh,
      v_total_pay,v_total_charge,v_total_charge-v_total_pay,v_vat_rate,v_vat,v_total,
      pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
        '','','',v_presentation_id,
        '',v_movement.work_event_id,
        '',v_manifest.id,'',pg_catalog.to_jsonb(v_ids)
      )||case when v_release_authority is null then ''::jsonb else jsonb_build_object('',v_release_authority) end||case when v_round_presentation is null then ''::jsonb else jsonb_build_object(
        '',v_round_presentation,
        '',case when (v_round_presentation->>'')::boolean
          then '' else '' end) end,''||v_presentation_id::text

insert into public.weekly_source_invoice_line_bindings(
        billing_movement_id,presentation_line_id,invoice_line_id,invoice_id,

      ) returning id into v_binding_id

insert into public.weekly_source_invoice_placements(
        billing_movement_id,source_shift_group_id,invoice_id,invoice_line_id,
        placement_revision,placement_state,is_current,original_automatic_cycle_id,
        current_target_cycle_id,placement_reason,actor_user_id,placement_hash
      ) values (

        '',true,v_invoice_window.id,v_invoice_window.id,
        '',v_actor,v_placement_hash
      )

update public.weekly_source_billing_movements
      set placement_state='' where id=v_member.id and placement_state=''

insert into public.weekly_source_expense_materialisations(
    expense_authority_generation_id,billing_movement_id,
    invoice_presentation_line_id,expense_lineage_hash,state
  )
  select movement.expense_authority_generation_id,
         (pg_catalog.array_agg(
           movement.id
           order by (movement.movement_role not in (
             '',''
           )),movement.id
         ))[1],
         (pg_catalog.array_agg(
           binding.presentation_line_id
           order by (movement.movement_role not in (
             '',''
           )),movement.id
         ))[1],
         private.weekly_source_sha256_jsonb_v1(
           '',
           pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
             '',movement.expense_authority_generation_id,
             '',pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(movement.id order by movement.id),
             '',pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(binding.presentation_line_id order by movement.id)
           )
         ),''
  from public.weekly_source_manifest_movements mm
  join public.weekly_source_billing_movements movement on movement.id=mm.billing_movement_id
  join public.weekly_source_invoice_line_bindings binding
    on binding.billing_movement_id=movement.id and binding.state=''
  where mm.client_manifest_id=v_manifest.id
    and movement.expense_authority_generation_id is not null
  group by movement.expense_authority_generation_id

update public.weekly_source_client_manifests set invoice_state=''
  where id=v_manifest.id and invoice_state=''

insert into public.audit_events(
    ts_utc,actor_user_id,actor_display,actor_role_at_time,object_type,
    object_id_text,action,before_json,after_json,reason
  )
  select pg_catalog.statement_timestamp(),v_actor,actor.display_name,actor.role,
         '',v_invoice_id::text,'',null,
         pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
           '',v_manifest.id,'',v_manifest.source_cycle_id,
           '',v_manifest.client_id,'',v_manifest.movement_count,
           '',v_manifest.backing_report_number
         ),''
  from public.tms_users actor where actor.id=v_actor

routines.name: public.invoice_apply_edits
lockMutationStatements:
select *
  into v_inv
  from public.invoices i
  where i.id = p_invoice_id
  for update
  limit 1

IF v_correction_placement_only THEN
    IF COALESCE(cardinality(v_remove_ids),0)=1 THEN
      SELECT il.timesheet_id INTO v_correction_placement_ts_id
      FROM public.invoice_lines il
      WHERE il.id=v_remove_ids[1] AND il.invoice_id=p_invoice_id
      FOR UPDATE

for v_ref_ts in
      select t.*
      from public.timesheets t
      join jsonb_each(v_source_updates_map) desired on true
      where t.timesheet_id=(desired.value->>'')::uuid
      order by t.timesheet_id
      for update of t
    loop
      null

for v_ref_ts in
      select tf.id
      from public.timesheets_financials tf
      join jsonb_each(v_source_updates_map) desired
        on tf.timesheet_id=(desired.value->>'')::uuid
      where tf.is_current
      order by tf.timesheet_id,tf.id
      for update of tf
    loop
      null

if exists(
      select 1 from jsonb_each(v_source_updates_map) desired
      where (desired.value->>'')::boolean
    ) then
      with desired as materialized(
        select (value->>'')::uuid as timesheet_id,value
        from jsonb_each(v_source_updates_map)
      )
      update public.timesheets t
      set updated_at=v_now,
          reference_number=case when (d.value->>'')::boolean
            then nullif(btrim(coalesce(d.value->>'','')),'')
            else t.reference_number end,
          day_references_json=case when (d.value->>'')::boolean
            then case when jsonb_typeof(d.value->'')=''
              then null else d.value->'' end
            else t.day_references_json end,
          actual_schedule_json=case
            when (d.value->>'')::boolean
              and d.value->>''<>''
            then d.value->''
            else t.actual_schedule_json end,
          hospital_norm=case when (d.value->>'')::boolean
            then coalesce(d.value->>'','') else t.hospital_norm end,
          ward_norm=case when (d.value->>'')::boolean
            then coalesce(d.value->>'','') else t.ward_norm end
      from desired d
      where t.timesheet_id=d.timesheet_id
        and (d.value->>'')::boolean
        and t.is_current

update public.timesheets tsu
      set
        updated_at = v_now,
        reference_number = case when v_refupd_set_refnum then v_refupd_refnum else tsu.reference_number end,
        day_references_json = case when v_refupd_set_dayrefs then v_refupd_dayrefs else tsu.day_references_json end,
        actual_schedule_json = case when v_refupd_set_sched then v_refupd_sched else tsu.actual_schedule_json end
      where tsu.timesheet_id = v_refupd_ts_id
        and tsu.is_current = true
        and exists(
          select 1
          from public.invoice_lines owned_line
          where owned_line.invoice_id=p_invoice_id
            and (
              owned_line.timesheet_id=tsu.timesheet_id
              or (
                owned_line.timesheet_id is null
                and coalesce(owned_line.meta_json->>'','')
                  ~ ''
                and (owned_line.meta_json->>'')::uuid=tsu.timesheet_id
              )
            )
        )
        and (
          (v_refupd_set_refnum and tsu.reference_number is distinct from v_refupd_refnum)
          or (v_refupd_set_dayrefs and tsu.day_references_json is distinct from v_refupd_dayrefs)
          or (v_refupd_set_sched and tsu.actual_schedule_json is distinct from v_refupd_sched)
        )

update public.timesheets tsu
      set updated_at=v_now,
          hospital_norm=case when v_location_set_hospital
            then v_location_hospital_norm else tsu.hospital_norm end,
          ward_norm=case when v_location_set_ward
            then v_location_ward_norm else tsu.ward_norm end
      where tsu.timesheet_id=v_location_ts_id
        and tsu.is_current=true
        and exists(
          select 1
          from public.invoice_lines owned_line
          where owned_line.invoice_id=p_invoice_id
            and (
              owned_line.timesheet_id=tsu.timesheet_id
              or (
                owned_line.timesheet_id is null
                and coalesce(owned_line.meta_json->>'','')
                  ~ ''
                and (owned_line.meta_json->>'')::uuid=tsu.timesheet_id
              )
            )
        )
        and (
          (v_location_set_hospital
            and tsu.hospital_norm is distinct from v_location_hospital_norm)
          or (v_location_set_ward
            and tsu.ward_norm is distinct from v_location_ward_norm)
        )

if v_refupd_ts_ids is not null and coalesce(array_length(v_refupd_ts_ids,1),0) > 0 then

    with desired as materialized(
      select value
      from jsonb_each(v_source_updates_map)
      where (value->>'')::boolean
    )
    update public.timesheets_financials tf
    set invoice_breakdown_json=jsonb_set(
      coalesce(tf.invoice_breakdown_json,''::jsonb),
      '',d.value->'',true)
    from desired d
    where tf.id=(d.value->>'')::uuid
      and tf.is_current
      and tf.timesheet_id=(d.value->>'')::uuid
      and upper(coalesce(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->>'',''))=''
      and tf.invoice_breakdown_json->''
        is distinct from d.value->''

update public.invoice_lines ilu
      set meta_json = coalesce(ilu.meta_json, ''::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
        '', nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_ref_ts.reference_number,'')), ''),
        '', coalesce(v_ref_schedule_refs_distinct, ''::jsonb),
        '', jsonb_array_length(coalesce(v_ref_schedule_refs_distinct, ''::jsonb))
      )
      where ilu.invoice_id = p_invoice_id
        and (
          ilu.timesheet_id=v_ref_ts_id
          or (
            ilu.timesheet_id is null
            and coalesce(ilu.meta_json->>'','') ~
              ''
            and (ilu.meta_json->>'')::uuid=v_ref_ts_id
          )
        )
        and (
          ilu.meta_json->'' is distinct from
            coalesce(to_jsonb(nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_ref_ts.reference_number,'')),'')),''::jsonb)
          or ilu.meta_json->'' is distinct from
            coalesce(v_ref_schedule_refs_distinct,''::jsonb)
          or ilu.meta_json->'' is distinct from
            to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(v_ref_schedule_refs_distinct,''::jsonb)))
        )

select tfu.id, tfu.invoice_breakdown_json
      into v_ref_tsfin_id, v_ref_ib
      from public.timesheets_financials tfu
      where tfu.timesheet_id = v_ref_ts_id
        and tfu.is_current = true
      limit 1
      for update

if v_ref_seg_updates_this_ts > 0 then
              update public.timesheets_financials tfu2
          set invoice_breakdown_json = jsonb_set(coalesce(tfu2.invoice_breakdown_json, ''::jsonb), '', v_ref_new_segments, true)
          where tfu2.id = v_ref_tsfin_id
            and tfu2.is_current = true

delete from public.invoice_lines
    where invoice_id = p_invoice_id
      and id = any(v_remove_ids)

update public.timesheets_financials tfu_lock
      set
        locked_by_invoice_id = null,
        locked_at_utc = null,
        updated_at = v_now
      where tfu_lock.is_current = true
        and tfu_lock.timesheet_id = any(v_ts_ids_fully_removed)
        and tfu_lock.locked_by_invoice_id = p_invoice_id

if jsonb_array_length(coalesce(segments,''::jsonb)) = 0 then
            delete from public.invoice_lines
            where invoice_id = p_invoice_id
              and timesheet_id = tsid

else
          
          if snap.locked_by_invoice_id is null then
            delete from public.invoice_lines
            where invoice_id = p_invoice_id
              and timesheet_id = tsid

if jsonb_array_length(coalesce(segments,''::jsonb)) = 0 then
        
        delete from public.invoice_lines
        where invoice_id = p_invoice_id
          and timesheet_id = tsid

delete from public.invoice_lines
      where invoice_id = p_invoice_id
        and timesheet_id = tsid
        and upper(coalesce(meta_json->>'','')) in ('','')

insert into public.invoice_lines(
              invoice_id, timesheet_id, booking_id, description,
              hours_day, hours_night, hours_sat, hours_sun, hours_bh,
              pay_day, pay_night, pay_sat, pay_sun, pay_bh,
              charge_day, charge_night, charge_sat, charge_sun, charge_bh,
              total_pay_ex_vat, total_charge_ex_vat, margin_ex_vat,
              vat_rate_pct, vat_amount, total_inc_vat,
              paper_ts_r2_key, meta_json, source_key
            )
            values (

              null,null,null,null,null,
              null,null,null,null,null,
              pay_ex, chg_ex, margin_ex,
              v_vat_rate, vat_amt, inc_amt,
              v_exact_timesheet_document_r2_key,
              v_meta,
              v_source_key
            )
            on conflict (invoice_id, source_key) do nothing

insert into public.invoice_lines(
    invoice_id, timesheet_id, booking_id, description,
    hours_day, hours_night, hours_sat, hours_sun, hours_bh,
    pay_day, pay_night, pay_sat, pay_sun, pay_bh,

  )
  values (

    h_day, h_night, h_sat, h_sun, h_bh,
    null,null,null,null,null,
    null,null,null,null,null,
    pay_ex, chg_ex, margin_ex,

    v_meta,
    v_source_key
  )
  on conflict (invoice_id, source_key) do nothing

insert into public.invoice_lines(
          invoice_id, timesheet_id, booking_id, description,
          hours_day, hours_night, hours_sat, hours_sun, hours_bh,
          pay_day, pay_night, pay_sat, pay_sun, pay_bh,

        )
        values (
          p_invoice_id, null, null, v_adj_desc,
          0,0,0,0,0,
          null,null,null,null,null,
          null,null,null,null,null,
          0, public._inv_round2(v_adj_ex), public._inv_round2(v_adj_ex),
          v_vat_rate, v_adj_vat, v_adj_inc,
          null,
          v_meta,
          v_adj_source_key
        )
        on conflict (invoice_id, source_key) do nothing

insert into public.invoice_lines(
        invoice_id,timesheet_id,booking_id,description,
        hours_day,hours_night,hours_sat,hours_sun,hours_bh,
        pay_day,pay_night,pay_sat,pay_sun,pay_bh,
        charge_day,charge_night,charge_sat,charge_sun,charge_bh,
        total_pay_ex_vat,total_charge_ex_vat,margin_ex_vat,
        vat_rate_pct,vat_amount,total_inc_vat,
        paper_ts_r2_key,meta_json,source_key
      )
      with base as materialized (
        select coalesce(
          (select nullif(btrim(coalesce(cd.display_name,'')),'')
             from public.candidates cd where cd.id=snap.candidate_id limit 1),
          ''||tsid::text
        ) candidate_display
      ),
      segment_rows as materialized (
        select
          case when left(coalesce(s.value->>'',''),10) ~ ''
            then left(s.value->>'',10) end work_date,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'','') then (s.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end h_day,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'','') then (s.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end h_night,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'','') then (s.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end h_sat,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'','') then (s.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end h_sun,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'','') then (s.value->>'')::numeric else 0 end h_bh,
          case
            when pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'','') then (s.value->>'')::numeric
            when pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'','') then (s.value->>'')::numeric
            else 0 end pay_ex,
          case
            when pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'','') then (s.value->>'')::numeric
            when pg_input_is_valid(s.value->>'','') then (s.value->>'')::numeric
            else 0 end charge_ex
        from jsonb_array_elements(segments) s(value)
      ),
      hour_daily as materialized (
        select s.work_date,sum(s.h_day) h_day,sum(s.h_night) h_night,sum(s.h_sat) h_sat,
          sum(s.h_sun) h_sun,sum(s.h_bh) h_bh,sum(s.pay_ex) pay_ex,sum(s.charge_ex) charge_ex
        from segment_rows s
        where c_daily_calc and s.work_date is not null
        group by s.work_date
      ),
      hour_weekly as materialized (
        select sum(s.h_day) h_day,sum(s.h_night) h_night,sum(s.h_sat) h_sat,
          sum(s.h_sun) h_sun,sum(s.h_bh) h_bh,sum(s.pay_ex) pay_ex,sum(s.charge_ex) charge_ex
        from segment_rows s
        having not c_daily_calc or not exists(select 1 from segment_rows d where d.work_date is not null)
      ),
      additional_source as materialized (
        select upper(a.key) code,a.value unit
        from jsonb_each(case when jsonb_typeof(snap.additional_units_json)=''
          then snap.additional_units_json else ''::jsonb end) a
        where jsonb_typeof(a.value)='' and btrim(a.key)<>''
      ),
      additional_daily as materialized (
        select a.code,left(d.key,10) work_date,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(d.value,'') then d.value::numeric else 0 end units,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(a.unit->>'','') then (a.unit->>'')::numeric else 0 end pay_rate,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(a.unit->>'','') then (a.unit->>'')::numeric else 0 end charge_rate,
          coalesce(nullif(a.unit->>'',''),a.code) bucket_name,
          coalesce(nullif(a.unit->>'',''),'') unit_name,
          a.unit->'' frequency
        from additional_source a
        cross join lateral jsonb_each_text(case when jsonb_typeof(a.unit->'')=''
          then a.unit->'' else ''::jsonb end) d
        where c_daily_calc
          and left(d.key,10) ~ ''
          and pg_input_is_valid(d.value,'')
          and d.value::numeric<>0
          and exists(select 1 from segment_rows where work_date is not null)
      ),
      additional_weekly as materialized (
        select a.code,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(a.unit->>'','') then (a.unit->>'')::numeric else 0 end units,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(a.unit->>'','') then (a.unit->>'')::numeric else 0 end pay_rate,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(a.unit->>'','') then (a.unit->>'')::numeric else 0 end charge_rate,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(a.unit->>'','') then (a.unit->>'')::numeric else 0 end pay_ex,
          case when pg_input_is_valid(a.unit->>'','') then (a.unit->>'')::numeric else 0 end charge_ex,
          coalesce(nullif(a.unit->>'',''),a.code) bucket_name,
          coalesce(nullif(a.unit->>'',''),'') unit_name,
          a.unit->'' frequency
        from additional_source a
        where not(c_daily_calc
          and exists(select 1 from jsonb_each_text(case when jsonb_typeof(a.unit->'')=''
            then a.unit->'' else ''::jsonb end) d
            where left(d.key,10) ~ ''
              and pg_input_is_valid(d.value,'') and d.value::numeric<>0))
          and (
            (case when pg_input_is_valid(a.unit->>'','') then (a.unit->>'')::numeric else 0 end)<>0
            or (case when pg_input_is_valid(a.unit->>'','') then (a.unit->>'')::numeric else 0 end)<>0
          )
      ),
      expense_lines as materialized (
        select e.code,e.pay_ex,e.charge_ex
        from (values
          ('',coalesce(snap.travel_pay_ex_vat,0),coalesce(snap.travel_charge_ex_vat,0)),
          ('',coalesce(snap.accommodation_pay_ex_vat,0),coalesce(snap.accommodation_charge_ex_vat,0)),
          ('',coalesce(snap.other_pay_ex_vat,0),coalesce(snap.other_charge_ex_vat,0)),
          ('',
            case when coalesce(snap.travel_pay_ex_vat,0)+coalesce(snap.accommodation_pay_ex_vat,0)+coalesce(snap.other_pay_ex_vat,0)=0
              then coalesce(snap.expenses_pay_ex_vat,0) else 0 end,
            case when coalesce(snap.travel_charge_ex_vat,0)+coalesce(snap.accommodation_charge_ex_vat,0)+coalesce(snap.other_charge_ex_vat,0)=0
              then coalesce(snap.expenses_charge_ex_vat,0) else 0 end),
          ('',coalesce(snap.mileage_pay_ex_vat,0),coalesce(snap.mileage_charge_ex_vat,0))
        ) e(code,pay_ex,charge_ex)
        where e.pay_ex<>0 or e.charge_ex<>0
      ),
      line_union as materialized (
        select b.candidate_display||''||h.work_date||''||coalesce(snap.week_ending_date::text,'' ) description,
          h.h_day,h.h_night,h.h_sat,h.h_sun,h.h_bh,h.pay_ex,h.charge_ex,
          '' line_type,''||tsid::text||''||h.work_date source_key,
          jsonb_build_object('',h.work_date) detail
        from hour_daily h cross join base b
        union all
        select b.candidate_display||''||coalesce(snap.week_ending_date::text,''),
          h.h_day,h.h_night,h.h_sat,h.h_sun,h.h_bh,h.pay_ex,h.charge_ex,
          '',''||tsid::text||'',''::jsonb
        from hour_weekly h cross join base b
        union all
        select b.candidate_display||''||a.bucket_name||''||a.work_date||''||a.units||''||a.unit_name,
          0,0,0,0,0,round(a.units*a.pay_rate,2),round(a.units*a.charge_rate,2),
          '',''||tsid::text||''||a.code||''||a.work_date,
          jsonb_build_object('',a.work_date,'',jsonb_build_object(
            '',a.code,'',a.bucket_name,'',a.unit_name,'',a.frequency),
            '',jsonb_build_object('',a.units,'',a.pay_rate,'',a.charge_rate))
        from additional_daily a cross join base b
        union all
        select b.candidate_display||''||a.bucket_name||''||a.units||''||a.unit_name,
          0,0,0,0,0,a.pay_ex,a.charge_ex,
          '',''||tsid::text||''||a.code||'',
          jsonb_build_object('',jsonb_build_object(
            '',a.code,'',a.bucket_name,'',a.unit_name,'',a.frequency),
            '',jsonb_build_object('',a.units,'',a.pay_rate,'',a.charge_rate))
        from additional_weekly a cross join base b
        union all
        select case when e.code='' then ''||coalesce(snap.mileage_units,0)||''||coalesce(snap.week_ending_date::text,'')||''
          when e.code='' then ''||coalesce(snap.week_ending_date::text,'')||''
          else initcap(replace(e.code,'',''))||''||coalesce(snap.week_ending_date::text,'')||'' end,
          0,0,0,0,0,e.pay_ex,e.charge_ex,
          case when e.code='' then ''
            when e.code='' then ''
            else ''||e.code end,
          case when e.code='' then ''||tsid::text||''
            when e.code='' then ''||tsid::text||''
            else ''||tsid::text||''||e.code end,
          jsonb_build_object('',case when e.code='' then jsonb_build_object(
            '','','',snap.mileage_units,
            '',snap.mileage_pay_rate,'',snap.mileage_charge_rate,
            '',snap.mileage_evidence_r2_key,'',snap.mileage_evidence_manifest)
            else jsonb_build_object('',e.code,'',snap.expenses_description,
              '',snap.expenses_evidence_r2_key,'',snap.expenses_evidence_manifest) end)
        from expense_lines e
      )
      select p_invoice_id,tsid,snap.booking_id,l.description,
        round(l.h_day,2),round(l.h_night,2),round(l.h_sat,2),round(l.h_sun,2),round(l.h_bh,2),
        null,null,null,null,null,
        snap.charge_day,snap.charge_night,snap.charge_sat,snap.charge_sun,snap.charge_bh,
        round(l.pay_ex,2),round(l.charge_ex,2),round(l.charge_ex-l.pay_ex,2),v_vat_rate,
        round(l.charge_ex*v_vat_rate/100,2),round(l.charge_ex+(l.charge_ex*v_vat_rate/100),2),
        v_exact_timesheet_document_r2_key,
        jsonb_build_object('',l.line_type,'',tsid,'',snap.id,
          '',l.description,'',snap.week_ending_date,
          '',c_role,'',c_display_site,'',c_ward_hint,'',c_bucket_labels,
          '',jsonb_build_object('',round(l.pay_ex,2),
            '',round(l.charge_ex,2),'',round(l.charge_ex-l.pay_ex,2),
            '',v_vat_rate,'',round(l.charge_ex*v_vat_rate/100,2),
            '',round(l.charge_ex+(l.charge_ex*v_vat_rate/100),2)))||l.detail,
        l.source_key
      from line_union l
      on conflict(invoice_id,source_key) do nothing

if coalesce(array_length(v_cw_ts_ids,1),0) > 0 then
    with src as (
      select
        cw.timesheet_id,
        cw.status as cw_status,
        tf.locked_by_invoice_id,
        tf.invoice_breakdown_json,
        (
          case
            when tf.invoice_breakdown_json is not null
             and jsonb_typeof(tf.invoice_breakdown_json)=''
             and coalesce(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->>'','')=''
             and jsonb_typeof(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'')=''
             and jsonb_array_length(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'') > 0
            then
              not exists (
                select 1
                from jsonb_array_elements(tf.invoice_breakdown_json->'') s(seg)
                where nullif(btrim(coalesce(s.seg->>'','')), '') is null
              )
            else
              (tf.locked_by_invoice_id is not null)
          end
        ) as fully_invoiced
      from public.contract_weeks cw
      join public.timesheets_financials tf
        on tf.is_current = true
       and tf.timesheet_id = cw.timesheet_id
      where cw.timesheet_id = any(v_cw_ts_ids)
    )
    update public.contract_weeks cw
    set status = case
      when src.fully_invoiced then ''::public.contract_week_status_enum

        WHEN v_action = '' THEN ''

        WHEN v_action IN ('', '') THEN ''
        WHEN v_action IN ('', '') THEN ''
        ELSE t_demote.revoked_reason

      revoked_by = CASE
        WHEN v_action IN ('', '', '', '', '', '', '', '')
        THEN p_actor_user_id::text

INSERT INTO public.timesheets (

      version, is_current, revoked_at, revoked_reason, revoked_by, contract_id,
      submission_mode, manual_pdf_r2_key, line_type, sheet_scope,
      actual_schedule_json, additional_units_week, additional_units_per_day,
      qr_token, qr_status, qr_payload_json, qr_generated_at, qr_scanned_at,

      ''::public.timesheet_status_enum, NULL, NULL, NULL, v_now, v_now,
      v_next_version, true, NULL, NULL, NULL, v_current_row.contract_id,
      
      
      
      
      
      ''::public.submission_mode_enum,
      NULL, v_current_row.line_type, v_current_row.sheet_scope,
      v_current_row.actual_schedule_json,
      coalesce(v_current_row.additional_units_week, ''::jsonb),
      coalesce(v_current_row.additional_units_per_day, ''::jsonb),
      NULL,
      CASE WHEN v_action IN ('', '', '')

      NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, v_current_row.correction_id,
      v_current_row.correction_kind, v_current_row.adjustment_origin,
      NULL, NULL, NULL, 1, '', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
      NULL, NULL, NULL,
      case
        when v_action='' and v_scope='' then ''
        when v_action in ('','','')
          and v_scope='' then ''
        else null
      end
    RETURNING * INTO v_new_row

UPDATE public.contract_weeks AS cw_upd
      SET

        submission_mode_snapshot = ''::public.submission_mode_enum,
        updated_at = v_now
      WHERE cw_upd.id = v_contract_week_row.id

ELSIF v_action IN ('', '', '', '', '', '') THEN
      IF v_contract_week_row.id IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE public.contract_weeks AS cw_move
        SET
          timesheet_id = v_new_timesheet_id,
          submission_mode_snapshot = CASE
            WHEN v_action = ''
              THEN ''::public.submission_mode_enum
            ELSE ''::public.submission_mode_enum
          END,
          updated_at = v_now
        WHERE cw_move.id = v_contract_week_row.id

UPDATE public.timesheets_financials AS tf_upd
      SET
        timesheet_id = v_new_timesheet_id,
        timesheet_version = coalesce(v_new_row.version, v_next_version),
        processing_status = CASE
          WHEN v_action IN ('', '') THEN
            CASE WHEN tf_upd.processing_status = ''::public.ts_fin_processing_status_enum
              THEN ''::public.ts_fin_processing_status_enum
              ELSE ''::public.ts_fin_processing_status_enum END
          ELSE tf_upd.processing_status
        END,
        authorised_by_user_id = NULL,
        authorised_at_utc = NULL,
        updated_at = v_now
      WHERE tf_upd.id = v_tsfin_row.id

ELSIF v_action IN ('', '', '', '') THEN
      IF v_tsfin_row.id IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE public.timesheets_financials AS tf_upd
        SET
          timesheet_id = v_new_timesheet_id,
          timesheet_version = coalesce(v_new_row.version, v_next_version),
          processing_status = CASE
            WHEN v_action = '' THEN ''::public.ts_fin_processing_status_enum
            WHEN v_action IN ('', '', '') THEN

                THEN ''::public.ts_fin_processing_status_enum
                ELSE ''::public.ts_fin_processing_status_enum END
            ELSE tf_upd.processing_status
          END,
          
          
          
          authorised_by_user_id = NULL,
          authorised_at_utc = NULL,

        WHERE tf_upd.id = v_tsfin_row.id

SELECT workflow.* INTO v_revert_workflow

SELECT request_row.* INTO v_revert_approval_request

    WHERE request_row.workflow_id=v_revert_workflow.id

      AND request_row.state IN ('','')
      AND request_row.approved_at_utc IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY request_row.approved_at_utc DESC,
      request_row.request_generation DESC,request_row.created_at_utc DESC

SELECT component.* INTO v_revert_hours_component

    WHERE component.id=v_revert_approval_request.manager_review_timesheet_component_id

      AND component.workflow_generation=v_electronic_row.candidate_workflow_generation
      AND component.component_kind=''
      AND component.required=true
      AND component.state=''
      AND component.final_signed_render_state=''
      AND component.final_signed_storage_key IS NOT NULL
      AND component.final_signed_content_sha256 IS NOT NULL
      AND component.final_signed_render_input_sha256 IS NOT NULL
      AND component.review_render_input_sha256=component.final_signed_render_input_sha256
    ORDER BY component.review_ordinal,component.id
    LIMIT 1
    FOR UPDATE

SELECT component.* INTO v_revert_candidate_signature
    FROM public.candidate_submission_components component
    WHERE component.id=v_revert_workflow.candidate_signature_component_id
      AND component.workflow_id=v_revert_workflow.id
      AND component.workflow_generation=v_electronic_row.candidate_workflow_generation
      AND component.component_kind=''
      AND component.state=''
      AND component.immutable_at_utc IS NOT NULL
      AND component.source_content_sha256=v_revert_workflow.candidate_signature_sha256
      AND component.storage_key=v_electronic_row.r2_nurse_key
    FOR UPDATE

SELECT component.* INTO v_revert_manager_signature

    WHERE component.id=v_revert_workflow.manager_signature_component_id
      AND component.workflow_id=v_revert_workflow.id
      AND component.workflow_generation=v_electronic_row.candidate_workflow_generation
      AND component.component_kind=''
      AND component.state=''
      AND component.immutable_at_utc IS NOT NULL
      AND component.approval_request_id=v_revert_approval_request.id
      AND component.source_content_sha256=v_revert_workflow.manager_signature_sha256
      AND component.storage_key=v_electronic_row.r2_auth_key
    FOR UPDATE

SELECT evidence.* INTO v_revert_evidence

    WHERE evidence.timesheet_id=v_electronic_row.timesheet_id
      AND upper(btrim(evidence.kind))=''
      AND evidence.processing_state<>''

IF v_contract_week_row.id IS NOT NULL THEN

routines.name: public.hr_weekly_apply_transactional
lockMutationStatements:
insert into tmp_review_batch_units(candidate_id,client_id)
  select distinct d.candidate_id,d.client_id
  from public.import_review_decisions d
  where d.import_id=p_import_id and d.is_current
    and d.action_id in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(v_review_guard->''))
    and d.candidate_id is not null and d.client_id is not null
  on conflict do nothing

insert into tmp_sel_ids(action_id)
  select distinct nullif(btrim(x.value), '')
  from jsonb_array_elements_text(v_actions_json) as x(value)
  where nullif(btrim(x.value), '') is not null
  on conflict do nothing

for v_weekly_source_family in
      select distinct btrim(family_timesheet.booking_id) as trimmed_booking_id,
        family_timesheet.booking_id as booking_id
      from unnest(coalesce(v_reauthorise_timesheet_ids,array[]::uuid[])) as scope(timesheet_id)
      join public.timesheets family_timesheet
        on family_timesheet.timesheet_id=scope.timesheet_id
      where family_timesheet.booking_id is not null
        and btrim(family_timesheet.booking_id)<>''
      order by 1,2
    loop
      perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(v_weekly_source_family.trimmed_booking_id))

if v_weekly_source_family.booking_id<>v_weekly_source_family.trimmed_booking_id then
        perform pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(v_weekly_source_family.booking_id))

perform 1 from public.timesheets locked_member
      where locked_member.booking_id=v_weekly_source_family.booking_id for update

perform 1 from public.timesheets exact_source
      where exact_source.timesheet_id=v_paid_timesheet_id
        and exact_source.is_current and exact_source.archived_at_utc is null for update

perform 1 from public.timesheets_financials current_lock
      where current_lock.timesheet_id=v_paid_timesheet_id and current_lock.is_current
      order by current_lock.id for update

select origin.* into v_paid_origin_operation from public.import_apply_operations origin
        where origin.id=(v_paid_current_tf.policy_snapshot_json->>'')::uuid for update

insert into tmp_selected_replacement_keys(candidate_id, client_id, old_work_date, replacement_day_key)
      select distinct
        (coalesce(ex.candidate_id, st.candidate_id))::uuid as candidate_id,
        (coalesce(ex.client_id, st.client_id))::uuid as client_id,
        ex.old_work_date as old_work_date,
        ((coalesce(ex.candidate_id, st.candidate_id))::text || '' ||
         (coalesce(ex.client_id, st.client_id))::text || '' ||
         (ex.old_work_date)::text) as replacement_day_key
      from tmp_sel_truth_p2 st
      join tmp_existing_by_key ex
        on ex.external_row_key = st.external_row_key
      where ex.old_work_date is not null
        and st.import_work_date is not null
        and ex.old_work_date <> st.import_work_date

insert into tmp_hr_mode_b_groups(contract_id, candidate_id, client_id, week_ending_date)
    select distinct
      p2ok.contract_id,
      p2ok.candidate_id,
      p2ok.client_id,
      p2ok.week_ending_date
    from tmp_p2_ok_mode p2ok
    where p2ok.mode = ''
      and p2ok.external_row_key = any(coalesce(v_force_keys_final, array[]::text[]))
      and p2ok.contract_id is not null
      and p2ok.candidate_id is not null
      and p2ok.client_id is not null
      and p2ok.week_ending_date is not null
    on conflict do nothing

if array_length(v_selected_cancel_shift_ids, 1) is not null then
      insert into tmp_hr_mode_b_groups(contract_id, candidate_id, client_id, week_ending_date)
      select distinct
        ns.contract_id,
        ns.candidate_id,
        ns.client_id,
        ns.week_ending_date
      from public.nhsp_shifts ns
      join public.contracts c_cancel on c_cancel.id = ns.contract_id
      cross join lateral public._import_review_effective_authority_core_v1(
        '',c_cancel.id,c_cancel.client_id,ns.week_ending_date) a_cancel
      where ns.id = any(v_selected_cancel_shift_ids)
        and ns.source_system = ''::public.hr_source_enum
        and ns.client_id = v_import_client_id
        and ns.contract_id is not null
        and ns.candidate_id is not null
        and ns.client_id is not null
        and ns.week_ending_date is not null
        and a_cancel.import_authoritative
      on conflict do nothing

insert into tmp_hr_mode_b_groups(contract_id, candidate_id, client_id, week_ending_date)
    select distinct
      ns.contract_id,
      ns.candidate_id,
      ns.client_id,
      ns.week_ending_date
    from public.nhsp_shifts ns
    join tmp_group_mode gm2
      on gm2.contract_id = ns.contract_id
     and gm2.candidate_id = ns.candidate_id
     and gm2.client_id = ns.client_id
     and gm2.week_ending_date = ns.week_ending_date
     and gm2.mode = ''
    where ns.source_system = ''::public.hr_source_enum
      and ns.cancelled_at_utc is null
      and ns.contract_id is not null
      and ns.candidate_id is not null
      and ns.client_id is not null
      and ns.week_ending_date is not null
      and (
        ns.external_row_key = any(coalesce(v_force_keys_final, array[]::text[]))
        or ns.id = any(coalesce(v_selected_cancel_shift_ids, array[]::uuid[]))
        or exists (
          select 1
          from tmp_hr_mode_b_groups g0
          where g0.contract_id = ns.contract_id
            and g0.candidate_id = ns.candidate_id
            and g0.client_id = ns.client_id
            and g0.week_ending_date = ns.week_ending_date

insert into tmp_hr_mode_b_created_ts_ids(timesheet_id)

insert into tmp_val_by_ts(timesheet_id, has_error, chosen_reason_code, chosen_hr_request_id)
  select
    vr.timesheet_id,
    bool_or(
      not (upper(coalesce(vr.status_text, '')) in ('','','',''))
    ) as has_error,
    case
      when bool_or(
        not (upper(coalesce(vr.status_text, '')) in ('','','',''))
      )
      then
        min(vr.reason_code) filter (
          where not (upper(coalesce(vr.status_text, '')) in ('','','',''))
        )
      else
        ''
    end as chosen_reason_code,
    max(vr.hr_request_id) as chosen_hr_request_id
  from tmp_val_raw vr
  group by vr.timesheet_id
